She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

title: Alteon Raises $2.5 Mn To Develop Long-Endurance Autonomous Aircraft
title_bn: Alteon Raises $2.5 Mn To Develop Long-Endurance Autonomous Aircraft
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Bengaluru-based startup Alteon has raised $2.5 Mn (about ₹24 Cr) in a pre-seed round led by Lachy Groom, with participation…
paragraph1: SUMMARYAlteon has raised $2.5 Mn in pre-seed funding to advance its wind-powered autonomous aircraft and work towards deploying fleets capable of staying airborne for months Alteon’s ultra-long-endurance aircraft could enable persistent ocean monitoring, defence and surveillance without the refuelling and infrastructure needed by conventional aircraft The Bengaluru-based startup recently demonstrated autonomous flight less than a metre above the ocean and is targeting aircraft that can eventually stay airborne for more than a year using dynamic soaring Bengaluru-based startup Alteon has raised $2.5 Mn (about ₹24 Cr) in a pre-seed round led by Lachy Groom, with participation from Together Fund, as it works on autonomous aircraft designed to stay airborne for months without landing. The fresh capital will be used to advance its autonomous dynamic-soaring technology, scale R&D and deploy fleets of aircraft over the ocean, the startup said in a statement. The funding comes shortly after Alteon’s aircraft completed an offshore flight test, autonomously flying multiple consecutive loops less than a metre above the ocean’s surface.
paragraph2: The test marked a key milestone in the startup’s efforts to develop ultra-long-endurance aircraft using dynamic soaring. The startup’s founder Samay Sanghvi began work on the tech driving the radio-controlled aircraft back in 2023 before incorporating the startup in 2025. He developed the prototypes without a formal engineering degree and received early backing from Emergent Ventures and 1517. The startup has since expanded its team to 20. Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft that use wind energy to stay airborne for months, similar to how albatrosses fly.
paragraph3: Unlike conventional aircraft that need to land for refueling and maintenance, the startup aims to build aircraft capable of persistent flight without relying on traditional propulsion. One of its key engineering challenges is enabling the aircraft to perform dynamic-soaring manoeuvres autonomously close to the surface of a moving ocean. “Ultra high endurance is downstream of ultra high efficiency, precision and reliability,” said Sanghvi. “Day in, day out we put our aircraft in the air and learn from every build, every flight and every failure to get closer to building aircraft that can stay airborne for more than a year.” The startup is ultimately aiming to build aircraft capable of staying airborne for more than a year, potentially enabling continuous observation of the oceans and helping authorities monitor activities such as illegal fishing and drug trafficking.
paragraph4: The fundraise comes as India’s UAV market continues to expand, driven by rising demand for unmanned systems across defence, surveillance, infrastructure and logistics. The market is also seeing a growing set of startups building autonomous and long-endurance aircraft. NewSpace Research & Technologies, CDSpace Robotics and Aspera Aerospace are also developing unmanned systems for defence and surveillance, while Airbound is building autonomous aircraft for logistics and recently raised $37 Mn in a Series A round. Meanwhile, eVTOLs are also expected to fill the Indian skies soon. Startups like LAT Aerospace, the E-Plane Company, Sarla Aviation, and BLUJ Aero, are furthering their bids to build electric flying taxis.
paragraph5: The development comes as India’s UAV market gains traction across commercial and defence applications, with the market valued at $470 Mn in 2025 and projected to reach $1.39 Bn by 2030 at a 24.

title: From $3.5 Bn To $200 Mn: upGrad Completes Unacademy Acquisition
title_bn: From $3.5 Bn To $200 Mn: upGrad Completes Unacademy Acquisition
author: TechPulse
excerpt: After months of negotiations and regulatory clearances, edtech major upGrad has completed its acquisition of Unacademy in a deal valued…
paragraph1: SUMMARYupGrad has completed its acquisition of Unacademy in a deal valued at just over $200 Mn, the latter’s cofounder Gaurav Munjal said The final transaction value represents a decline of more than 94% from Unacademy’s peak valuation of $3.5 Bn in 2021 Munjal said Unacademy had a topline of around ₹400 Cr, ₹900 Cr in the bank, and most of its businesses were profitable or nearing profitability at the time of the transaction After months of negotiations and regulatory clearances, edtech major upGrad has completed its acquisition of Unacademy in a deal valued at just over $200 Mn. Unacademy cofounder Gaurav Munjal announced the closure of the transaction in a post on X today. “We raised at a peak, but sold at a fraction of that.
paragraph2: I’m not going to dress these facts up. But I am proud of what this team did between those two numbers,” Munjal said. The final transaction value represents a decline of more than 94% from Unacademy’s peak valuation of $3.5 Bn in 2021.
paragraph3: The startup has raised more than $830 Mn to date from investors such as SoftBank, Peak XV Partners, Elevation Capital, Blume Ventures, and Meta. The acquisition will give Ronnie Screwvala-led upGrad a foothold in the K-12 and competitive exam preparation segments. upGrad primarily operates in the higher education and professional upskilling space. The CCI approved the deal in July.
paragraph4: Munjal said Unacademy was not forced into the transaction because of a cash crunch. At the time of the acquisition, Unacademy had a topline of around ₹400 Cr and about ₹900 Cr in the bank, while most of its businesses were profitable or close to profitability, he claimed. “With a topline of around 400 Cr, most businesses profitable or near-profitable, and 900 Cr in the bank, we had every option to keep going independently. Nobody was forcing this,” Munjal said.

title: OnePlus 16 leak reveals ‘final’ camera specs, and it’s what the OnePlus 15 should’ve had
title_bn: OnePlus 16 leak reveals ‘final’ camera specs, and it’s what the OnePlus 15 should’ve had
author: TechPulse
excerpt: A worthy successor to the OnePlus 13's camera system?
paragraph1: Ryan Haines / Android AuthorityTL;DR The OnePlus 16’s “final” camera specs have apparently leaked online. The phone is said to have a 200MP main camera, a new 50MP ultrawide camera, and a 50MP 3x camera. It looks like the 3x camera is virtually identical to the one seen on the OnePlus 13. The OnePlus 15 was a bit of a disappointment on the camera front compared to the OnePlus 13. However, various leaks in 2026 suggest that the OnePlus 16 could have upgraded camera hardware.
paragraph2: Now, a trusted tipster has revealed “final” camera specs.Leaker Digital Chat Station on Weibo has revealed what might be the definitive OnePlus 16 camera specs. Check out the machine-translated screenshot below.The leaker claims that the phone will have a 200MP 1/1.4-inch main camera, a 50MP 3x 1/1.
paragraph3: 95-inch telephoto shooter, and a 50MP ultrawide camera. This is rounded out by a 50MP selfie shooter with autofocus. Digital Chat Station also claims that the phone will inherit OPPO’s latest generation of flagship imaging tech.In other words, those early leaks about a 200MP telephoto camera weren’t accurate. The 50MP telephoto camera seems identical to the OnePlus 13’s 3x camera, though, and we praised the older phone for its camera zoom capabilities.
paragraph4: So it stands to reason that camera zoom quality should be on par with the OnePlus 13, if not a little better due to upgraded image processing. Nevertheless, we’re guessing this 200MP main camera will deliver improved image quality over the OnePlus 15’s relatively small 50MP primary shooter.Otherwise, the OnePlus 16 was previously tipped to arrive with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset, a 9,000mAh battery, and a 165Hz screen. So even if you can’t officially get your hands on this device in Europe or the US, you might want to add it to your wishlist.FollowThank you for being part of our community.

title: Kepler Aerospace Raises $8 Mn To Launch Six Autonomous Surveillance Satellites
title_bn: Kepler Aerospace Raises $8 Mn To Launch Six Autonomous Surveillance Satellites
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Spacetech startup Kepler Aerospace has raised $8 Mn (around ₹75.8 Cr) in a seed funding round led by Blue Ashva…
paragraph1: SUMMARYKepler Aerospace has raised $8 Mn in its maiden external funding round to deploy six autonomous swarming ISR satellites under two iDEX contracts The startup aims to reduce the time taken to deliver space-based intelligence from months to minutes by combining satellites, ground stations, and mission operations Kepler will also scale its mission operations and avionics businesses, move to a new facility, and add 40 employees over the next 12 to 24 months Spacetech startup Kepler Aerospace has raised $8 Mn (around ₹75.8 Cr) in a seed funding round led by Blue Ashva Capital and co-led by Finvolve, India Accelerator, and other investors. The round marks the Bengaluru-based startup’s first external fundraise since its inception in 2018. Kepler will use the fresh capital to develop and deploy its space-based intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities, while expanding its mission operations and avionics-as-a-service businesses. A key part of the funding will be used to launch its first six autonomous swarming ISR satellites under two iDEX contracts secured for India’s defence space ecosystem. The programmes have also received around $4 Mn in grants under iDEX.
paragraph2: ISR satellites monitor designated areas from space and collect information that can be used for defence and national security operations. Kepler claims its proposed satellites will be capable of communicating with, assigning tasks to, and acting in coordination with one another in orbit without waiting for instructions from a ground station. The startup said it aims to reduce the time taken to convert space-based data into actionable intelligence from months to minutes through these persistent ISR systems and its integrated mission infrastructure. Kepler’s Space Infrastructure Play Founded by Navneet Singh and Kiran V Sharma, Kepler builds and operates infrastructure required across the lifecycle of a satellite mission. The startup makes satellite avionics and subsystems, including onboard computers, power systems, radio frequency payloads, and communication and navigation modules. These are electronic systems installed inside satellites to control their operations, power supply, navigation, and communication.
paragraph3: It also provides ground station and mission operations services. These allow satellite operators to communicate with, track, control, and receive data from their satellites after they are placed in orbit. Kepler’s third focus area is space-based intelligence, under which it plans to operate satellites that collect and process surveillance data for defence and national security applications. In simple terms, the startup makes some of the electronic systems used inside satellites, provides the ground infrastructure required to operate them, and is now building its own satellites to collect defence intelligence. Kepler said its mission operations platform serves nearly all Indian space companies and acts as the primary mission operator for several ISRO satellites. The startup also claimed that it provides satellite communication, tracking, telemetry, command, and mission operations services through a network of more than 70 ground stations.
paragraph4: Over the next 12 to 24 months, Kepler will focus on deploying the satellites, expanding its mission operations and avionics-as-a-service businesses, and strengthening its engineering capabilities. The startup is also moving to a new facility and plans to add 40 employees to its existing team. The shift is already visible in the growing capabilities of Indian spacetech startups. In July, spacetech unicorn Skyroot Aerospace became the first private Indian company to place a rocket into orbit, with its Vikram-1 launch vehicle completing Mission Aagaman after lifting off from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. Meanwhile, Agnikul Cosmos onboarded former ISRO chairman S Somanath as an observer on its board as the startup prepares for its second space mission.
paragraph5: The mission will involve recovering an orbital-class rocket booster and extending the rocket’s upper stage into an on-orbit platform. At the heart of this push is India’s commercial spacetech market, which is projected to reach $77 Bn by 2030, growing at a CAGR of 26%.

title: Apple alleges former engineer accessed circuit plans while at OpenAI
title_bn: Apple alleges former engineer accessed circuit plans while at OpenAI
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple alleged that a former engineer accessed proprietary circuit plans after joining artificial intelligence company OpenAI, as per a news report by Reuters, citing a filing submitted in a United States federal court.
paragraph1: Apple alleged that a former engineer accessed proprietary circuit plans after joining artificial intelligence company OpenAI, as per a news report by Reuters, citing a filing submitted in a United States federal court.Apple alleges former engineer accessed circuit plans while at OpenAINew Delhi [India], September 1 (ANI): Apple alleged that a former engineer accessed proprietary circuit plans after joining artificial intelligence company OpenAI, as per a news report by Reuters, citing a filing submitted in a United States federal court.In the court submission, Apple stated that a defendant in its trade secret case against ChatGPT creator OpenAI accessed a power converter circuit schematic while working at the artificial intelligence firm."Apple, opens new tab on Monday alleged that a defendant in its trade secret case against ChatGPT creator OpenAI accessed a power converter circuit schematic while at OpenAI, according to a filing in U.
paragraph2: S. federal court," Reuters said.Apple identified the former employee as Chang Liu, who previously worked as a senior system electrical engineer at Apple. The company alleged that Liu accessed the power converter circuit and trained an artificial intelligence agent using proprietary Apple information in March 2026.
paragraph3: According to the news report, the information surfaced during the formal exchange of materials between the legal teams. Apple stated that the new evidence came to light from a MacBook computer that OpenAI provided to Apple on August 21 as part of the ongoing legal proceedings.Following the examination of the device, Apple moved the US federal court with a request to accelerate the process of obtaining further evidence. Apple asked the court to expedite discovery proceedings in the trade secret case against OpenAI.
paragraph4: OpenAI sought to challenge the legal action brought by Apple. The artificial intelligence firm asked the court to dismiss the lawsuit entirely.In addressing the dispute over its technology and design processes, OpenAI defended its development work against the trade secret allegations.OpenAI maintained that it is building products that are "entirely new."
paragraph5: The legal proceedings between the two technology companies continue in US federal court as Apple pushes for expedited discovery of the case.

title: Yuma Energy Bags $35 Mn To Expand Its Battery Swapping Network
title_bn: Yuma Energy Bags $35 Mn To Expand Its Battery Swapping Network
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Battery swapping platform Yuma Energy has raised $35 Mn (₹333 Cr) in its Series A funding round from existing backer…
paragraph1: SUMMARYThe startup plans to use the fresh proceeds to expand its battery swapping network, broaden its customer base and strengthen its tech platform Yuma’s fundraise signals that battery swapping is becoming a scalable business, which could influence how India’s E2W market will grow over the next decade Going forward, Yuma plans to broaden its customer base to serve a wider mix of EV users, fleet operators and OEMs. It is also eyeing EBITDA-profitability by FY27 Battery swapping platform Yuma Energy has raised $35 Mn (₹333 Cr) in its Series A funding round from existing backer and Canada-based automotive giant Magna International. The startup plans to use the fresh proceeds to expand its battery swapping network across India, broaden its customer base and strengthen its tech platform. As part of the deal, Yuma Energy and Magna will also work together to scale the former’s presence in the electric two- and three-wheeler ecosystem.
paragraph2: “… Crossing 6 Cr swaps was a defining moment for us, and with Magna’s support, we’re accelerating our infrastructure rollout and deepening our partnerships with fleets and OEMs (original equipment manufacturers) to make swapping the default choice for every electric two and three-wheeler on Indian roads.” said Yuma managing director Muthu Subramanian. Founded in 2023 as a joint venture (JV) between Magna and electric mobility platform Yulu Energy, Yuma Energy offers battery swapping infrastructure and services for electric vehicles (EVs). While Yulu then contributed certain assets and intellectual property for a 49% stake, Magna infused $52 Mn in the startup for a controlling 51% stake in the JV.
paragraph3: Yuma Energy operates more than 2,500 charging stations across 18 Indian cities. It also claims to have accumulated 1 Lakh batteries and delivered more than 6 Cr battery swaps so far. Going forward, the startup said that it plans to broaden its customer base to serve a wider mix of EV users, fleet operators and OEMs. It is also eyeing EBITDA-profitability by FY27.
paragraph4: Yuma operates in the growing Indian battery swapping market, which is being driven by novel products, need for convenience and substantial capital subsidies from the government. However, despite rising EV registrations, the lack of adequate charging infrastructure across the country remains a major hurdle. To fill this gap, EV charging and infrastructure ventures continue to attract healthy interest from investors. In July, EV charging startup Statiq raised $18 Mn, via a mix of equity and debt, in a round led by Tenacity Ventures.
paragraph5: Prior to this in June, EV charging startup Exponent Energy also bagged ₹200 Cr in a round co-led by 360 ONE Asset and TDK Ventures. Earlier last month, reports also surfaced that battery swapping startup Battery Smart was looking to list on the bourses, with plans to file the DRHP by October. At the heart of all this is the Indian EV market, which is projected to become a $132 Bn opportunity by 2030.

title: Meta removes scam ads after India flags explicit-content bait luring users to download phishing apps
title_bn: Meta removes scam ads after India flags explicit-content bait luring users to download phishing apps
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Meta removed fraudulent ads from Facebook and Instagram after India flagged scams with baits of explicit content while promoting malicious apps. The apps could steal users’ credentials, OTPs and bank PINs. Cyber fraud losses in India reached $2.4 bil
paragraph1: Meta removed fraudulent ads from Facebook and Instagram after India flagged scams with baits of explicit content while promoting malicious apps. The apps could steal users’ credentials, OTPs and bank PINs. Cyber fraud losses in India reached $2.4 billion in 2025.Image for representation.
paragraph2: (Pixabay, Unsplash)Meta removed numerous advertisements on Monday after India flagged a pattern of ads on Facebook as well as Instagram in which explicit content was being used to lure users into downloading fraudulent apps that could steal their personal credentials and drain their bank accounts, Reuters reported.Around $2.4 billion was recorded in losses from cyber frauds in India in 2025 alone, as per government data seen by Reuters. The digital payments boon in the country is being an increasing target of online scammers.As per the Indian government, ads were running on both Facebook and Instagram, operating under names like 'Kyss' and 'Night Play', which directed users to phishing websites as soon as they clicked on these links.
paragraph3: The government said that it has been observing an increase in financial fraud involving “malicious Android applications masquerading as pornography apps”.The news agency found around 39 such websites were still active even after an advisory on the same was issued by the government on Monday. A number of these websites had thumbnails depicting sexually explicit content, which helped attract more clicks.Reuters reported that one such ad, which was a promotion for a video app that promised users hundreds of pornographic content, asked users to directly download a file with the name "Movexa.apk" outside of an official app store.
paragraph4: The advisory issued by the Indian government says that these apps can secretly access private information stored in the phones of users, capture one-time passwords, their bank PINs, as well as transfer money from their accounts without their knowledge.Meta removed all of these ads soon after the same was flagged to the company by Reuters, the news agency reported.Meta, as per its own policies, says that ads "must not contain adult nudity and sexual activity". The company also prohibits ads for products, services, schemes or offers using identified deceptive or misleading practices", as well as those that are intended to scam people out of their money.This is the second time in recent days that India has raised concerns with the tech giant about financial frauds occurring via its social media sites.
paragraph5: Earlier, the government of India had also directed Google to clamp down on hundreds of accounts on Firebase once it was discovered that scammers were using the platform to impersonate major banks.As per an internal projection of Meta, banned goods' advertising or scams through its platforms would generate around 10% of the revenue it earned in 2024, which comes to around $16 billion.

title: Tim Cook’s 15-year Apple legacy: From Steve Jobs's successor to $4 trillion giant
title_bn: Tim Cook’s 15-year Apple legacy: From Steve Jobs's successor to $4 trillion giant
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO after nearly 15 years, leaving behind a company worth over $4 trillion. His tenure was marked by explosive iPhone growth, a booming services business, stronger margins and a highly efficient global supply chain.
paragraph1: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO after nearly 15 years, leaving behind a company worth over $4 trillion. His tenure was marked by explosive iPhone growth, a booming services business, stronger margins and a highly efficient global supply chain.Apple CEO Tim Cook.(AFP)Tim Cook is stepping down as Apple CEO after nearly 15 years at the helm. He will move into the executive chairman role, while John Ternus, head of Apple's hardware division, will take charge of daily operations from 1 September. Cook became CEO in August 2011, just before Steve Jobs's death, and succeeded one of the most influential founders in the technology industry.Cook built a very different Apple from the one Jobs left behind. His tenure was defined less by breakthroughs and more by scale, operational discipline, services, supply chain control and greater monetization of Apple's huge device base. This approach made Apple one of the world's most valuable companies, but leaves Ternus with major challenges around China, regulators and artificial intelligence.From Steve Jobs' successor to Apple’s growth architectCook's greatest success was the expansion of the iPhone business. During his tenure, Apple sold approximately 3.
paragraph2: 1 billion iPhones, according to International Data Corporation (IDC) data.Apple's stock also delivered exceptional returns. The Financial Times reports it has more than tripled since Cook's arrival, with over $1 trillion to shareholders through buybacks and dividends.The tech giant's workforce grew from about 60,000 in 2011 to roughly 166,000 today, while its retail footprint expanded to more than 500 stores worldwide.Turning Apple into a services machineOne of Cook’s most important moves was reducing Apple's reliance on hardware sales. The App Store, Apple Music, iCloud and Apple Pay became central to business. The Financial Times estimates Apple now has 1.5 billion paying subscribers.View full ImageTim Cook, chief executive officer of Apple Inc., holds an iPhone 15 Pro Max during an event at Apple Park campus in Cupertino, California, US, on Tuesday, Sept. 12, 2023.
paragraph3: Apple Inc. introduced its latest iPhones at an event Tuesday, banking on new materials, camera upgrades and improved performance to coax back consumers in a sluggish smartphone market. Photographer: David Paul Morris/Bloomberg(Bloomberg)Apple also boasts that more than 2.5 billion Apple devices are in use globally, a massive installed base that has become one of its biggest competitive strengths.Supply chain became Tim Cook’s signatureCook's background in operations shaped his leadership. He built an efficient manufacturing and supply chain network, with China at its core.This model allowed Apple to produce hundreds of millions of devices while maintaining margins. Operating margins improved significantly under his tenure.But the same system backfired when US-China tensions escalated. The Financial Times reported that about 90% of Apple's suppliers were partly based in China or Taiwan. Apple's market value fell by $638 billion over three days in April 2025 after US President Donald Trump imposed sweeping tariffs.
paragraph4: Cook responded by promoting diversification while sustaining ties with China.Five new hardware categories in 15 yearsCook's influence on Apple's product lineup was less dramatic than Jobs's. The iPhone, Mac and iPad remained core, but five new hardware categories emerged: AirTag and Vision Pro, Apple Watch, AirPods and HomePod.View full ImageApple CEO Tim Cook holds up a new iPhone 17 Pro during an Apple special event at Apple headquarters on September 09 in Cupertino, California. Apple unveiled a new generation of iPhones and updated Apple Watches and AirPods during a special event at Apple headquarters. (Photo: Getty Images via AFP)The Watch and AirPods became runaway successes. Apple ended its long-running car project in 2024, while HomePod and Vision Pro remained niche products. Cook’s less visible hardware legacy was Apple's move to design its own chips. The transition to Apple Silicon boosted performance and strengthened Apple’s control over its products.View full ImageTrump, Apple announce $100 billion US boost, total investment hits $600 billion(REUTERS)Tim Cook leaves behind a $4 trillion giantCook leaves behind a $4 trillion Apple built on scale, supply‑chain mastery and services growth. As he moves to the executive chairman role, Ternus inherits both the company’s record valuation and some of its toughest strategic questions — from innovation and China dependence to regulatory scrutiny and AI.

She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

author: TechPulse
excerpt: TP-Link’s Wi-Fi 8 launch remains complicated in the US due to ongoing FCC restrictions
paragraph1: (Image credit: TP-Link) Earlier this year, TP-Link announced its intentions to launch the first members of its Wi-Fi 8 (802.11bn) networking family. At the time, the company revealed that it would first launch a standalone Archer 8 consumer router this fall, followed by a Deco 8 mesh router. And right on cue, TP-Link stated today that the Archer 8 Ultra BN19000 tri-band router will launch on September 30.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centersTP-Link is going light on the details at this time, but this is what we know so far. The Archer 8 Ultra BN19000 will come equipped with 18 internal antennas and deliver up to 19 Gbps aggregate wireless speeds. In addition, it will have 10 Gbps wired connectivity, though we don’t know whether that includes WAN and LAN ports or just the latter.
paragraph2: For users who require broader coverage in larger homes or offices, the Deco 8 Ultra BN22000 tri-band mesh router offers aggregate speeds of up to 22 Gbps and includes 10 Gbps wired connectivity. TP-Link typically sells its mesh systems in two- or three-pack configurations, and the Deco 8 Ultra BN22000 3-pack covers up to 9,800 square feet. Unfortunately, the Wi-Fi 8 mesh system won’t be available until Q1 2027, according to TP-Link.TP-Link plans to expand its Wi-Fi 8 portfolio by Q2 2027 with a new Roam 8 travel router, along with range extenders and PCIe/USB client adapters. Although we don’t know which specific chipsets will power Archer 8 Ultra, Deco 8 Ultra, and other unannounced Wi-Fi 8 devices, the company says its products will use hardware from Broadcom, MediaTek, and Qualcomm.Wi-Fi 8 is shaping up to be more of a quality-of-life improvement over Wi-Fi 7 than a substantial theoretical speed improvement. Put simply, Wi-Fi 8 hardware devices should be able to come closer to fulfilling the real-world performance metrics that Wi-Fi 7 devices originally promised.
paragraph3: To this end, TP-Link says that its so-called StabilityEngine leverages core Wi-Fi technologies including Enhanced Long Range (ELR) and Distributed Resource Units (DRU). These features together help improve wireless connectivity, primarily for low-power IoT devices that are typically positioned at the edge of your home’s wireless coverage. There are also additional technologies at play, such as Unequal Modulation (UEQM) and Modulation and Coding Schemes (MCS), to ensure uninterrupted wireless traffic in high-interference situations.A new design language is also being ushered in with the Archer 8 and Deco 8 products, which was teased during TP-Link’s May 2026 announcement. “We stopped building a piece of networking equipment and started designing for the home,” explained TP-Link industrial design chief Gary Chang. “When a router’s design becomes something people want to display, it ends up exactly where it performs best.”Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
paragraph4: What remains unclear is how or when these new Wi-Fi 8 products will launch in the U.S. As of today, TP-Link has yet to obtain FCC approval to release all-new products in the country. Unlike competitors Amazon and Netgear, which received conditional approval from the FCC Covered List, the U.S. government is still playing hardball with TP-Link. For its part, TP-Link only says that preorders for the Archer 8 Ultra will open in “select regions” on September 30.

title: Zepto’s New Game Plan, Layoffs At Zomato & More
title_bn: Zepto’s New Game Plan, Layoffs At Zomato & More
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Zepto’s Retention Playbook After postponing its IPO in July, Zepto is now trying to fix its unit economics. The quick…
paragraph1: Zepto’s Retention Playbook After postponing its IPO in July, Zepto is now trying to fix its unit economics. The quick commerce giant is pulling back on discounts, increasing free-delivery thresholds and pushing a paid loyalty programme to chase profitability. But why is it suddenly tightening the leash? Zepto’s Many Problems: Zepto’s IPO deferment stemmed from valuation concerns. Investors baulked at the startup’s $7 Bn valuation, citing high cash burn and industry-lowest AOV of ₹387. On top of this, its transacting user base shrank by more than 3% QoQ to 47.97 Mn in Q4 FY26. Compounding this pressure, Zepto had a free cash flow of ₹4,330 Cr at the end of March 2026, leaving it with just over one year of runway. These issues appear to have forced a critical re-evaluation of its aggressive scale-first strategy. But how is Zepto trying to fix these issues? Zepto Ditches Discounts: The quick commerce major has raised its free-delivery threshold to ₹199 for normal hours and up to ₹299 during peaks, aligning with its rivals. Platform-led discounts have fallen from 18-20% of MRP at the time of IPO filing to 14-16% now, with further moderation expected. The goal: Lift net order value, even if some small-ticket volumes migrate to other alternatives. The Premium Push: The unicorn recently launched Zepto Club, a paid membership plan that offers cashback, priority service and exclusive discounts. The move shifts incentives behind a paywall, targeting retention over acquisition.
paragraph2: Simultaneously, Zepto Select is pushing premium and gourmet groceries to lift basket sizes and margins. The Execution Test: Zepto no longer leads with its “everyday low prices” pitch. Instead, it’s betting on subscriptions, premiumisation and disciplined discounting to narrow losses. Without the safety nets that rivals Blinkit and Instamart have, the pressure is higher on the Aadit Palicha-led platform. So, can Zepto prove its execution edge and deliver profitability alongside growth? Let’s find out… RECOMMENDED FOR yOU From The Editor’s Desk ✂️ Layoffs At Zomato Eternal’s food delivery arm has shut down its customer support operations in Hyderabad and fired around 240 employees. Following the closure, Zomato’s remaining in-house customer support team will be consolidated in Gurugram. The move is part of Zomato’s bid to overhaul its customer support operations. In April last year, the company laid off around 600 employees across Gurugram and Hyderabad, citing AI-led automation. Separately, Zomato announced a ban on dishes containing analogue dairy products, warning non-compliant restaurants that they would be delisted. Eateries have also been directed to either transition to natural dairy products or remove items 🔔 Purple Style Labs’ IPO Day 1 The Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent’s public issue was subscribed to by only 8% by the end of the first day of bidding. Retail investors accounted for most of the demand, subscribing their quota by 39%, while NIIs subscribed their portion by 4%. Meanwhile, enterprise cloud company ESDS Software Solution’s IPO was subscribed 18.34X on the second day, receiving bids for 22.65 Cr shares against the 1.
paragraph3: 24 Cr shares on offer. Purple Style Labs’ public consists solely of a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹680 Cr, with no OFS component. ESDS’ ₹720 Cr IPO also comprises only a fresh issue of shares. Both companies are looking to list on the BSE and the NSE. ⛔ Satvacart Shuts Down The decade-old online grocery startup has shut down and disbanded its team after failing to secure growth capital. The startup explored funding, strategic investment and acquisition opportunities before deciding to wind up operations. Founded in 2014, Satvacart started as an online grocery delivery startup, offering groceries and other essentials to consumers in Gurugram. It subsequently pivoted to quick commerce. It raised $2 Mn before shutting down. Satvacart joins a growing list of Indian startups that have shut shop in 2026. Social networking platforms Medial and PicSee shut shop earlier this year, followed by quick commerce startup Klydo and online matchmaking platform Juleo. 🍺 Rumblings Continue At Bira91 The alcobev brand is facing a fresh insolvency scare. Glass manufacturer Hindusthan National Glass & Industries has served a default notice to Bira91 over alleged unpaid dues to the tune of ₹11.8 Cr. HNGIL claims to have manufactured 51 Lakh customised glass bottles for Bira91, but the orders were not allegedly lifted by the brewer.
paragraph4: The notice gives B9 Beverages 10 days to clear the dues or bring on record evidence of a pre-existing dispute. The fresh insolvency threat comes as Bira 91 continues to grapple with a severe financial crisis. The company has been out of production since September 2025 amid mounting debt, outstanding employee and vendor dues, and the ouster of the founder. 🛵 E2W Sales Take A Hit In August Electric two-wheeler registrations declined 16.2% to 1.72 Lakh units in August as against 2.05 Lakh units in July. This was the second consecutive month of decline. On A YoY basis, registrations jumped 64% from 1.05 Lakh units in the year-ago period. Market leader TVS Motor led the charge and clocked 46,587 registrations, despite a substantial 17% MoM dip. Meanwhile, Bajaj Auto continued to strengthen its position in the market and processed 45,861 E2W registrations, taking its market share to 22.5%. New-age EV player Ola Electric also saw a 7.7% MoM decline in registrations during the month to 13,132 units, while Ather recorded 27,218 registrations, down 11% from 30,632 in July.
paragraph5: Inc42 Markets Inc42 Startup Spotlight Can Vimag Labs Eliminate Rare Earth Magnets In EV Motors? India’s heavy dependence on Chinese rare earth magnets leaves the local auto industry exposed to supply disruptions and export restrictions. Vimag Labs is tackling this vulnerability with a platform that replaces permanent magnets with a virtual, real-time controlled magnetic field. Vimag’s Virtual Magnets: Founded in 2025, Vimag Labs has developed a virtual magnet synchronous motor (VMSM), which uses copper windings, steel and power electronics to generate a magnetic field that is continuously adjusted by proprietary control algorithms. This eliminates slip rings while maintaining a brushless synchronous motor design. From Patents To Pilots: Having secured multiple Indian patents for its motor platform, Vimag Labs claims to have completed over 87,600 engineering hours on the core architecture. It has also piloted its offering with multiple OEMs. The startup targets sectors such as EVs, industrial equipment, defence and energy systems. Global Ambitions: Backed by Accel, the startup also operates development centres in Germany, the US and Poland. Going forward, it plans to expand manufacturing in India and launch products across multiple EV categories over the next year. With the homegrown rare earth magnet market projected to grow to $1 Bn by 2034, can Vimag Labs help India break its reliance on Chinese magnets? title: Zepto’s Retention Play: Fewer Discounts, Premium Carts & A Paid Club
title_bn: জেপটো'র রিয়েটেনশন প্লেঃ কম ছাড়, প্রিমিয়াম কার্ট এবং একটি পেইড ক্লাব
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Before we turn the talk to Zepto’s IPO delay and how the company is looking to address the one problem…
paragraph1: Before we turn the talk to Zepto’s IPO delay and how the company is looking to address the one problem that’s been chiefly highlighted in the run up to the IPO, we need to perhaps revisit one key claim made by Aadit Palicha almost exactly two years ago. After raising more than $1 Bn in 2024 at a valuation of $5 Bn, Palicha said investors are backing Zepto’s execution. That was August 2024 and since then we can argue that Zepto has vindicated that backing to some extent as its revenue more than doubled to ₹22,623.6 Cr at the end of FY26 from ₹11,109.9 Cr in FY25. But consolidated net loss jumped 26% YoY in FY26 to ₹5,905 Cr from ₹4,699.7 Cr in FY25, which is the other side of that VC balance. And today, it’s arguably the heavier side as Zepto’s IPO plans were put on hold. In the weeks since Zepto deferred its $1.2-1.3 Bn public issue, speculation has emerged about the reasons. Some put it down to the valuation Zepto was seeking through the IPO. Reports suggested that major mutual funds felt the startup’s $7 Bn private market valuation was not justifiable given the trading multiples for Eternal and Swiggy, the parent companies of Blinkit and Instamart.
paragraph2: Plus, Zepto’s losses are significantly higher than those two major rivals, so there was some rationale behind this feeling of Zepto asking for a premium valuation without the basis for it. What we cannot know is whether these reports based on unnamed sources are necessarily the reason behind the deferment. There could be multiple factors, and in any case, Zepto says it remains committed to listing soon. Zepto is now in the process of raising a ₹1,000 Cr round ahead of the proposed listing, which it intends to complete within the timeframe provided by SEBI when it approved the updated draft red herring prospectus in June 2026. Nevertheless, the concerns over the rich valuation persist. What is Zepto doing to allay these fears? The Zepto Profitability Factor While Zepto relied on a jump in order volumes, crossing an average of 2.33 Mn orders a day through 1,139 dark stores as of March 2026, it also reported the industry’s lowest average order value (AOV) of ₹387 compared to Blinkit at ₹665–669 and Instamart’s AOV of ₹700 in FY26. Sources say that discount-fuelled scale in volumes and revenue of Zepto had proven to be a bottleneck in getting the institutional investors to agree on its profitability path and milestone. Despite a clear improvement in unit economics compared to previous years, Zepto has failed to curtail its losses as we highlighted above. Diving deeper, we find that the startup reported a free cash flow deficit of ₹4,330 Cr in FY26. One can surmise that dark store additions, customer acquisition costs and operational investments proved to be a drag. As per its current cash reserves and FY26 cash burn levels, Zepto seems to have a runway of roughly 1.
paragraph3: 3 years, which is not a sign of great health in an industry that’s relatively underpenetrated outside the metros. And compounding that issue, Zepto also witnessed a small drop in its annual transacting user base. The startup’s UDRHP revealed that its user base declined from 49.54 Mn in the December 2025 quarter to 47.97 Mn in the March 2026 quarter. We’ll come to why that may be the case, but the biggest reason is that Zepto has curtailed discounts as new players such as Flipkart Minutes, Amazon, JioMart have relied on discounts to acquire new users. Free Delivery & Discounts Out? Sources say that in response to these potential concerns, the quick commerce startup has pulled back discounts further, paused its aggressive dark store expansion in the metros and is focusing on customer retention rather than new customer acquisition. The new goal is profitability in more orders and across more dark stores, which will boost the overall bottom line. Backing this, a Bernstein Research report accessed by Inc42 says India’s quick commerce industry is expected to enter a slow expansion mode by 2027. Major platforms such as Eternal’s Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart and Zepto had already reached a milestone of 1,000 dark stores across top cities which drive a majority of the total demand and order volumes, the report said. It summarised that there is a likelihood that these key players will take a cautious approach towards the opening of new stores, which are the most detrimental to the unit economics in the quick commerce space. But there are other things that Zepto is doing.
paragraph4: Over the past several weeks, it has raised its free delivery threshold twice and pulled back on blanket cashbacks. It has also revived a paid loyalty programme that moves discounts and cashbacks behind a monthly subscription rather than offering it to every user who opens the app. “Blinkit and Instamart had been steady on pricing and delivery fees since last year, with their performances under public markets review and focus on profitability. Zepto, on the other hand, introduced free delivery on orders above ₹99, removing surge, handling charges, etc., which almost forced the industry to revive its discount strategy by November 2025,” an operations head at a top quick commerce platform stated. This practice may well be on the wane now, at least for Zepto. Whether it forces others also to change the tune is yet to be seen. RECOMMENDED FOR yOU Zepto’s minimum order value for free delivery has moved from ₹99 to ₹149, and now to ₹199 in normal hours, rising as high as ₹299 during peak demand, bringing it in line with Blinkit and Instamart, both of which already sat at ₹199. Kotak Institutional Equities has interpreted the move as an attempt by Zepto to bring down its quarterly burn, while analysts have also pointed to the possibility of higher net order value and better economics on smaller orders. However, there are also apprehensions raised that although maximising the free delivery limits has the potential to increase basket sizes, it can also result in the loss of small-ticket-size order volumes for Zepto. This falls in line with the user attrition as many users would shift to other newer platforms that may be offering a lower threshold for free delivery. The same tension is playing out in discounts. Zepto’s aggressive discounting over the past year was part of a broader fight for market share, especially against Flipkart Minutes and Amazon Now.
paragraph5: Discounts are a relatively straightforward way to persuade Indians to switch from one app to another. But insiders at Zepto say the unit economics have become increasingly difficult to manage with discounts. “The problem is that the customer is not merely being acquired at a discount, but more or less wants this incentive for every subsequent order,” a Zepto supply chain manager said, not wishing to be named. This meant many users broke up their orders into multiple orders and increased the utilisation of the delivery fleet without necessarily adding positively to the unit economics. Industry analysts now expect to see a moderation in this behaviour. Bernstein foresees a broader reduction in discounting across quick commerce. Bernstein’s report published in August 2026 stated that discounts on Zepto have come down heavily from 18-20% of the MRP of products at the time of IPO filing to roughly 14-16% now. “The platform-led discounts are going to slow down further with moderation in new customer acquisitions and in fact the focus will be heavily now tilted towards retaining the existing customer base by improved services,” Bernstein says in its report. It further highlights that if the discounts wave sustains through the festive season, it may indicate a shift in focus towards sustainable economics across the industry. Zepto Club: Moving Discounts Behind A Paywall Discounts are still around but they have shifted from the overall customer base to loyal users, a clear sign of a focus on retention over new acquisition. And this is where Zepto Club comes in.
bangla_paragraph1: জিপ্টো'র আইপিও বিলম্ব এবং কোম্পানি কীভাবে মূলত আইপিঅ'র আগে হাইলাইট করা হয়েছে এমন একটি সমস্যা সমাধানের চেষ্টা করছে সে সম্পর্কে কথা বলার আগে, আমাদের সম্ভবত আদিত পালিচা প্রায় ঠিক দুই বছর আগে যে মূল দাবি করেছিলেন তা পুনর্বিবেচনা করা দরকার। ২০২৪ সালে ৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারের মূল্যায়নে ১ বিলিয়ন ডলার উত্থাপনের পরে, পালিখা বলেছিলেন যে বিনিয়োগকারীরা জিপ্টোর কার্যকরকরণকে সমর্থন করছেন। এটি ছিল ২০২২ সালের আগস্ট এবং তারপর থেকে আমরা যুক্তি দিতে পারি যে জিপটো তার আয় হিসাবে কিছু পরিমাণে সমর্থনকে সমর্থন করেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এছাড়াও, জেপ্টোর ক্ষতিগুলি সেই দুটি প্রধান প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীগুলির তুলনায় উল্লেখযোগ্যভাবে বেশি, তাই এর ভিত্তি ছাড়াই জেপ্টোর প্রিমিয়াম মূল্যায়ন চাইতে এই অনুভূতির পিছনে কিছু যুক্তি ছিল। আমরা যা জানতে পারি না তা হ'ল নামহীন উত্সের উপর ভিত্তি করে এই প্রতিবেদনগুলি অবশ্যই স্থগিতের পিছনে কারণ কিনা। একাধিক কারণ থাকতে পারে এবং যে কোনও ক্ষেত্রে, জেপ্পটো বলে যে এটি শীঘ্রই তালিকাভুক্ত করার জন্য প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ। জেপটো এখন প্রস্তাবিত তালিকাভর্তির আগে ₹1,000 কোটি রাউন্ড বাড়ানোর প্রক্রিয়াধীন, যা
bangla_paragraph3: এই সমস্যাটি আরও জটিল করে তোলে যে, জেপটো তার বার্ষিক লেনদেনকারী ব্যবহারকারীর বেসেও সামান্য হ্রাস পেয়েছে। স্টার্টআপ ইউডিআরএইচপি প্রকাশ করেছে যে তার ব্যবহারকারী বেস ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫ ত্রৈমাসিকের ৪৯.৫৪ মিলিয়ন থেকে কমে ২০২৬ সালের মার্চ ত্রৈमाসিকের মধ্যে ৪৭.৯৭ মিলিয়ন হয়েছে। আমরা কেন এটি হতে পারে তা নিয়ে আসব, তবে সবচেয়ে বড় কারণ হ'ল জেপ্টো নতুন খেলোয়াড় যেমন ফ্লিপকার্ট মিনিটস, অ্যামাজন এর মতো ছাড়গুলি হ্রাস করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: গত কয়েক সপ্তাহ ধরে, এটি তার বিনামূল্যে বিতরণ থ্রেশহোল্ডটি দুবার বাড়িয়েছে এবং কম্বল ক্যাশব্যাকগুলি প্রত্যাহার করেছে। এটি একটি অর্থ প্রদানের আনুগত্য প্রোগ্রামও পুনরুজ্জীবিত করেছে যা অ্যাপটি খোলার প্রতিটি ব্যবহারকারীর কাছে এটি সরবরাহ করার পরিবর্তে মাসিক সাবস্ক্রিপশনের পিছনে ছাড় এবং ক্যাশেব্যাক সরিয়ে দেয়। ব্লিংকিট এবং ইনস্টামার্ট গত বছর থেকে মূল্য নির্ধারণ এবং বিতরণ ফিতে স্থিতিশীল ছিল, তাদের পারফরম্যান্স পাবলিক মার্কেট পর্যালোচনা এবং লাভজনকতার উপর ফোকাস করে। অন্যদিকে, জেপটো,
bangla_paragraph5: ডিসকাউন্ট হল ভারতীয়দের একটি অ্যাপ থেকে অন্যটিতে স্যুইচ করতে বোঝানোর তুলনামূলকভাবে সহজ উপায়। কিন্তু জেপটোর অভ্যন্তরীণ ব্যক্তিরা বলছেন যে ডিসকন্টের মাধ্যমে ইউনিট অর্থনীতি পরিচালনা করা ক্রমবর্ধমান কঠিন হয়ে উঠেছে। সমস্যাটি হ'ল গ্রাহককে কেবল ছাড়ে অর্জন করা হচ্ছে না, তবে প্রতিটি পরবর্তী অর্ডারের জন্য কমবেশি এই উদ্দীপনা চায়", জেপ্টো সাপ্লাই চেইন ম্যানেজার বলেছেন, নাম প্রকাশ না করে। এর অর্থ অনেক ব্যবহারকারী তাদের অর্ডারগুলিকে একাধিক অর্ডারে বিভক্ত করেছেন এবং ব্যবহার বৃদ্ধি করেছেন।

title: Lachy Groom backs Indian startup aiming to keep aircraft aloft for a year
title_bn: এক বছরের জন্য বিমান উড়তে দেয়ার লক্ষ্যে ভারতীয় স্টার্টআপকে সমর্থন করলেন ল্যাচি গ্রুম
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Founded by a 20-year-old, Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft that hopes to harvest wind energy to stay aloft for several months.
paragraph1: Prominent solo investor Lachy Groom has backed a Bengaluru startup attempting an ambitious feat: keeping an aircraft in the sky for more than a year by harvesting energy from ocean winds. Alteon, founded by 20-year-old Samay Sanghvi, announced Tuesday that it raised $2.5 million in a pre-seed round led by Groom, with participation from Together Fund, to develop autonomous aircraft inspired by dynamic soaring, a technique albatrosses use to extract energy from the wind. Groom decided he wanted to invest within the first 30 minutes of their first meeting, Sanghvi told TechCrunch. Conventional aircraft need to carry the fuel or battery power required for a flight. Alteon is trying to break that limitation by designing its small, fixed-wing autonomous aircraft that can extract energy from wind shear above the ocean through dynamic soaring — a maneuver in which an aircraft repeatedly moves between layers of air traveling at different speeds. “Once you build airplanes that can stay in the air for more than a year, there are millions of things you can do with them,” Sanghvi told TechCrunch. Alteon plans to initially use the aircraft for maritime surveillance, giving governments real-time visibility into activity in their waters.
paragraph2: The initial plan is to build an aircraft with around a three-meter-wingspan that will fly close to the ocean’s surface, climb, and turn through faster-moving air, and repeat the cycle to gain energy from the wind. Eventually, Alteon plans to use its propellers as turbines to convert some of that energy into electricity and recharge its onboard batteries, Sanghvi said. Alteon Founder Samay SanghviImage Credits:Alteon However, the startup has not yet demonstrated that its aircraft can actually sustain flight using energy harvested through dynamic soaring. It did complete a recent of its test of its autonomous flight system over the Bay of Bengal in which the aircraft autonomously completed seven O-shaped cycles at more than 62 miles per hour, flying within one meter of the water’s surface. Alteon’s next major milestone will be what Sanghvi calls “energy-neutral dynamic soaring.” This would allow the aircraft to fly continuously with its propulsion switched off, extracting enough energy from the wind to remain aloft. Dr. Gabriel Bousquet, a Silicon Valley-based aerospace and robotics engineer who researched dynamic soaring during his PhD at MIT, called Alteon’s low-altitude flight over water a “promising first result.
paragraph3: ” But he noted that the harder challenge will be proving that the aircraft can reliably extract enough energy from real-world winds to sustain flight for extended periods. Flying low enough to harvest that energy safely is particularly difficult, Bousquet told TechCrunch, as the aircraft would have to contend with turbulence, waves, spray, rain, and changing light conditions while continuously sensing and reacting to a moving ocean surface. Dr. Bharath Swaminathan, who earned his PhD from IIT Madras studying the stability of dynamic soaring, said the underlying physics is well established and called Alteon’s effort commendable. Keeping an aircraft airborne for several days using dynamic soaring would itself be “a very big step, and a big achievement,” he told TechCrunch. Swaminathan, however, added that while large-scale wind conditions may be predictable, local wind shear and turbulence can vary substantially, complicating an aircraft’s ability to continuously extract energy from the wind. Some of those challenges, he suggested, may only emerge through real-world flight testing. Groom acknowledged the technical risk behind the bet.
paragraph4: “Ambitious problems are always going to come with risks,” he told TechCrunch. “For me, it came down to believing Samay and the Alteon team are the ones to figure them out.” Sanghvi began working on what would become Alteon straight out of high school in 2023, learning to build aircraft by making — and crashing — radio-controlled models before developing early prototypes. He formally founded Alteon in 2025 and received early backing from Emergent Ventures and 1517. Alteon now has a team of 20 in Bengaluru and operates from a 10,000-square-foot facility. The startup is building four to five aircraft a week for testing and has conducted more than 200 test flights in the past 30 days, Sanghvi said. bangla_paragraph2: আলটিওন এর প্রাথমিক পরিকল্পনা হল সমুদ্রের পৃষ্ঠের কাছাকাছি উড়তে, আরোহণ করতে এবং দ্রুত গতিতে চলমান বায়ু দিয়ে ঘুরে বেড়াতে এবং বায়ু থেকে শক্তি পাওয়ার জন্য চক্রটি পুনরাবৃত্তি করতে প্রায় তিন মিটার উইংপ্যানের একটি বিমান তৈরি করা। শেষ পর্যন্ত, আলটিউন তার প্রিপেলারগুলিকে টারবাইন হিসাবে ব্যবহার করার পরিকল্পনা করেছে যাতে সেই শক্তির কিছুকে বিদ্যুতের মধ্যে রূপান্তরিত করতে পারে এবং তার বোর্ড ব্যাটারিগুলি পুনরায় চার্জ করতে পারে, সংঘভি বলেছিলেন। আলটিইউন প্রতিষ্ঠাতা সামাই সংঘবি চিত্র ক্রেডিটঃ আলটিয়ন তবে স্টার্টআপটি এখনও প্রমাণ করেনি যে তার বিমানটি আসলে স্থায়ী হতে পারে।
bangla_paragraph3: তবে তিনি উল্লেখ করেছিলেন যে আরও কঠিন চ্যালেঞ্জটি হ'ল প্রমাণ করা যে বিমানটি দীর্ঘ সময়ের জন্য বিমান চালিয়ে যাওয়ার জন্য বাস্তব বিশ্বের বাতাস থেকে পর্যাপ্ত শক্তি নির্ভরযোগ্যভাবে বের করতে পারে। এই শক্তিটি নিরাপদে সংগ্রহ করার জন্য যথেষ্ট কম উড়ানো বিশেষত কঠিন, বুসকেট টেকক্রাঞ্চকে বলেছিলেন, কারণ বিমানটি ধাক্কা, তরঙ্গ, স্প্রে, বৃষ্টি এবং পরিবর্তিত আলোর অবস্থার সাথে মোকাবিলা করতে হবে, যখন অবিচ্ছিন্নভাবে একটি চলমান মহাসাগরের পৃষ্ঠকে অনুভব করে এবং প্রতিক্রিয়া জানায়।
bangla_paragraph4: উচ্চাভিলাষী সমস্যা সবসময় ঝুঁকি নিয়ে আসে, তিনি টেকক্রাঞ্চকে বলেছেন। আমার জন্য, এটি বিশ্বাস করা সমাই এবং অ্যালটিওন দল তাদের খুঁজে বের করার জন্য। ️ সংঘভি উচ্চ বিদ্যালয়ের ঠিক বাইরে ২০২৩ সালে অ্যালটোন হয়ে উঠবে এমন কিছুর উপর কাজ শুরু করেছিলেন, প্রাথমিক প্রোটোটাইপগুলি বিকাশের আগে বিমান তৈরি এবং ক্র্যাশ করে বিমান তৈরি করতে শিখতে। তিনি আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে ২০২৫ সালে অালটিওনের প্রতিষ্ঠা করেছিলেন এবং এমারজেন্ট ভেঞ্চারস এবং ১৫১৭ থেকে প্রাথমিক সমর্থন পেয়েছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph5: জগমিত টেকক্রাঞ্চের জন্য স্টার্টআপস, প্রযুক্তি নীতি সম্পর্কিত আপডেট এবং ভারতের অন্যান্য সমস্ত প্রধান প্রযুক্তি কেন্দ্রিক উন্নয়নকে কভার করে। তিনি পূর্বে এনডিটিভিতে প্রধান সংবাদদাতা হিসাবে কাজ করেছিলেন। আপনি জগমিটের সাথে যোগাযোগ বা ইমেল করে যোগাযোগ করতে পারেন।

title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
title_bn: অ্যাপল অপেনএআই-র জন্য কোম্পানির তথ্য চুরি করার অভিযোগে সাবেক কর্মচারীর বিরুদ্ধে শঙ্কামূলক প্রমাণ শেয়ার করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.
paragraph1: Image Credits:Kirby Lee / Getty Images 5:13 PM PDT · August 31, 2026 In its lawsuit against OpenAI, Apple filed what it calls “shocking evidence” to bolster its allegations that former employees stole trade secrets for OpenAI’s benefit. These new details emerged after the legal counsel for former Apple employee Chang Liu — who now works at OpenAI — handed over Liu’s old Apple work laptop for investigation earlier this month. Apple now alleges that Liu used a confidential Apple circuit schematic in his work at OpenAI, as well as a tool that shares a name with an internal Apple engineering application. The company claims that OpenAI was “well-aware” of Liu’s access to Apple data, and that Liu enlisted OpenAI colleague Yu-Ting Peng to help destroy evidence in June when he learned that Apple was investigating him. “The MacBook represents the very limited information Defendants provided so far (and only after weeks of delay), and shows Apple is not conducting ‘fishing expeditions’ but that its trade secrets are being used and evidence is being destroyed,” the filing reads.
paragraph2: While this new evidence is redacted from public view, past filings from Apple have included text messages from Liu — which he punctuated with “crying laughing” emojis — showing he was aware that he still had access to Apple files. OpenAI has previously defended Liu by saying that he only accessed Apple files after he stopped working there in order to help former colleagues who asked for his assistance. “Apple now tries to shift the blame to ‘residual access,’ but they also don’t disclose that this is a common issue with Apple which is caused by them failing to properly manage system access when people leave,” OpenAI wrote in a blog post earlier this month. But Apple claims that Liu had continued access because he “exploited a rare, previously unknown authentication bug.” TechCrunch has requested comment from OpenAI on Apple’s newest allegations.
paragraph3: Apple is seeking a preliminary injunction — a court order that would block OpenAI from working on hardware based on Apple’s technology while the case is ongoing — as well as expedited discovery, a fast-tracked process for gathering evidence, since the company alleges that more former employees may also be implicated. According to Apple’s initial filing, more than 400 former Apple employees now work at OpenAI. Topics When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission. bangla_paragraph1: Image Credits:Kirby Lee / Getty Images 5:13 PM PDT · আগস্ট 31, 2026 ওপেনএআই-র বিরুদ্ধে মামলায় অ্যাপল তার অভিযোগকে শক্তিশালী করার জন্য  হতবাক প্রমাণ হিসাবে অভিহিত করেছে যে প্রাক্তন কর্মচারীরা ওপেনএইআই-এর সুবিধার জন্য বাণিজ্যিক গোপনীয়তা চুরি করেছে। এই নতুন বিবরণগুলি প্রাক্তনের আইনী পরামর্শদাতা চেং লিউয়ের পরে প্রকাশিত হয়েছিল। যিনি এখন ওপেনআই-তে কাজ করেন তিনি এই মাসের শুরুতে তদন্তের জন্য লিউ'র পুরানো অ্যাপল কাজের ল্যাপটপটি হস্তান্তর করেছিলেন। অ্যাপল এখন দাবি করে যে লিউ একটি গোপনীয় অ্যাপল সার্কিট স্কিম্যাটিক ব্যবহার করেছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph2: যদিও এই নতুন প্রমাণটি জনসাধারণের দৃষ্টি থেকে মুছে ফেলা হয়েছে, অ্যাপলের অতীতের ফাইলিংগুলিতে লিউ  এর পাঠ্য বার্তাগুলি অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে যা তিনি কান্না হাসি  ইমোজি সহ চিহ্নিত করেছেন  যা দেখায় যে তিনি এখনও অ্যাপল ফাইলগুলিতে অ্যাক্সেস পেয়েছিলেন। ওপেনএআই এর আগে লিউকে রক্ষা করেছিল যে তিনি কেবলমাত্র অ্যাপল ফাইলে অ্যাকসেস করেছিলেন বলে তিনি সেখানে কাজ বন্ধ করার পরে তার সহায়তা চেয়েছিলেন এমন প্রাক্তন সহকর্মীদের সহায়তা করার জন্য। অ্যাপল এখন  অবশিষ্ট অ্যাকসেসে দোষ দেওয়ার চেষ্টা করছে, তবে তারা এটি প্রকাশ করে না
bangla_paragraph3: অ্যাপল একটি প্রাথমিক নিষেধাজ্ঞা চাইছে  একটি আদালতের আদেশ যা মামলা চলার সময় অ্যাপলের প্রযুক্তির উপর ভিত্তি করে হার্ডওয়্যার কাজ থেকে ওপেনএআইকে বাধা দেবে  পাশাপাশি দ্রুত আবিষ্কার, প্রমাণ সংগ্রহের জন্য একটি দ্রুত ট্র্যাক প্রক্রিয়া, যেহেতু সংস্থাটি দাবি করে যে আরও প্রাক্তন কর্মচারীরাও জড়িত থাকতে পারে। অ্যাপলের প্রাথমিক ফাইলিং অনুসারে, 400 এরও বেশি প্রাক্তনের অ্যাপল কর্মচারি এখন ওপেনএইতে কাজ করে। বিষয়গুলি আপনি যখন আমাদের নিবন্ধগুলির লিঙ্কগুলির মাধ্যমে ক্রয় করেন, আমরা একটি ছোট কমিশন উপার্জন করতে পারি।
bangla_paragraph4: তিনি পলগন, এমটিভি, কেনিয়ন রিভিউ, এনপিআর এবং বিজনেস ইনসাইডার এর মতো প্রকাশনাগুলির জন্যও লিখেছেন। তিনি বিজ্ঞান কল্পকাহিনী লেখক ইসাবেল জে কিমের সাথে ইন্টারনেট সংস্কৃতি সম্পর্কে একটি পডকাস্ট ওয়াও ইফ ট্রুয়ের সহ-হোস্ট। টেকক্রাঞ্চে যোগদানের আগে তিনি গ্রাসরুট সংগঠক, জাদুঘর শিক্ষাবিদ এবং চলচ্চিত্র উৎসব সমন্বয়কারী হিসাবে কাজ করেছিলেন। তিনি বি।
bangla_paragraph5: এন্ডা এন্ডারসন, পেনসিলভানিয়া বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে ইংরেজিতে স্নাতক ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন এবং লাওসে প্রিন্সটন ইন এশিয়া ফেলো হিসাবে কাজ করেছেন। আপনি amanda@techcrunch.com এ ইমেল করে বা @amanda.100 এ এনক্রিপ্ট করা বার্তার মাধ্যমে সিগন্যালের মাধ্যমে আমান্ডার সাথে যোগাযোগ বা নিশ্চিত করতে পারেন।

title: Qualcomm Raising Chip Prices Starting Tomorrow
title_bn: Qualcomm Raising Chip Prices Starting Tomorrow
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Qualcomm is increasing prices for its chips by double digits starting tomorrow. Qualcomm announced the impending price hike back in July, letting customers know prices would go up for chips shipped after September 1. Qualcomm said it cannot continue
paragraph1: Monday August 31, 2026 4:39 pm PDT by Juli CloverQualcomm is increasing prices for its chips by double digits starting tomorrow. Qualcomm announced the impending price hike back in July, letting customers know prices would go up for chips shipped after September 1. Qualcomm said it cannot continue to absorb increasing supplier costs. "We're just passing through big cost increases that we have," said Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon in an interview with Reuters. Apple has been transitioning to its own modem chips, but it is still sourcing modem chips from Qualcomm for the iPhone 17 models.
paragraph2: Apple will discontinue the iPhone 17 Pro models when the iPhone 18 Pro is released in September, but it is likely to keep the ‌iPhone 17‌ in the lineup. Apple's iPhone 17e and iPhone Air use its C1X modem, and rumors suggest some ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models and the foldable iPhone could use a new Apple-designed C2 chip with faster 5G speeds. Apple may still rely on Qualcomm for modem chips in the United States, according to leaked iPhone 18 Pro documents from Tata Electronics. Prices have gone up for DRAM and storage due to supply issues, which has affected most device manufacturers. Apple raised prices of Macs and iPads in June, and the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models are expected to be more expensive than their predecessors.
paragraph3: Amon also said in July that Qualcomm is expecting the revenue it earns from Apple to decline faster than previously anticipated, dropping approximately 50 percent from the September quarter to the December quarter. He blamed supply constraints, which will reduce the share of Qualcomm components used in the iPhone 18 lineup. In addition to supplying modem chips to Apple, Qualcomm makes mobile chips for Samsung and other smartphone manufacturers. Qualcomm is raising prices across its lineup, and increases will be negotiated with customers individually. title: a16z brings growth fund to $8.5B days after launching new $1.1B fund
title_bn: নতুন ১.১ বিলিয়ন ডলারের তহবিল চালু হওয়ার কয়েকদিন পরেই এ১৬জেডের বৃদ্ধির তহবিলে ৮.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলার এসেছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Andreessen Horowitz held out its hand and returned with billions more in new funds to invest in startups.
paragraph1: In Brief Posted: 4:14 PM PDT · August 31, 2026 Image Credits:David Paul Morris/Bloomberg / Getty Images Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz has expanded its fifth growth fund to $8.5 billion. That means the firm added another $1.
paragraph2: 75 billion since the fund launched in January with $6.75 billion. The firm’s announcement comes just days after a16z announced it had raised a fresh $1.
paragraph3: 1 billion for a new and different fund that it’s calling the “Machine Age Fund.” The fund’s throwback, steampunk-esque name reflects its focus on AI hardware startups developing chips, memory, networking, and storage. As the growth fund’s name implies, it is cash dedicated to funding growth-stage startups that are ramping up products, expanding into new geographies, and scaling just about everything else.
paragraph4: Over seven years, the growth fund has invested in more than 100 companies, David George, a general partner who leads the growth investment team, wrote in his announcement blog. But in this age of AI, companies are reaching the growth stage faster and gobbling up more cash at higher valuations than ever, too. With these billions, a16z is pursuing enterprise and consumer AI tech, defense tech, robotics, infrastructure hardware and software, and health tech — really the whole stack.
paragraph5: In this election year, it is also spending big on politics and lobbying. These new funds follow the $15 billion in new funding a16z announced in January. At the time, it had $90 billion of assets under management.
bangla_paragraph1: In Brief Posted: 4:14 PM PDT · আগস্ট 31, 2026 চিত্র ক্রেডিটঃডেভিড পল মরিস/ব্লুমবার্গ/গেটি ইমেজ ভেঞ্চার ক্যাপিটাল ফার্ম অ্যান্ড্রেসেন হরোভিটস তার পঞ্চম গ্রোথ ফান্ডকে ৮.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারে বাড়িয়েছে। এর অর্থ হল ফার্মে আরও ১ ডলার যোগ হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: জানুয়ারিতে ৬.৭৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারের সাথে এই তহবিল চালু হওয়ার পর থেকে ৭৫ বিলিয়নের বেশি। এ ১৬জ ঘোষণা করার মাত্র কয়েক দিন পরেই এই ফার্মের এই ঘোষণা এসেছে।
bangla_paragraph3: মেশিন এজ ফান্ড নামে একটি নতুন এবং ভিন্ন তহবিলের জন্য ১ বিলিয়ন ডলার। ফান্ডের স্টিমপঙ্ক-প্রকারের নামটি চিপ, মেমরি, নেটওয়ার্কিং এবং স্টোরেজ বিকাশকারী এআই হার্ডওয়্যার স্টার্টআপগুলিতে এর ফোকাসকে প্রতিফলিত করে। যেমনটি বৃদ্ধির তহবিলের নাম থেকে বোঝা যায়, এটি বৃদ্ধির পর্যায়ে স্টার্ট আপগুলিকে অর্থায়নে নিবেদিত নগদ যা পণ্যগুলি বাড়িয়ে তুলছে, নতুন ভৌগলিক অঞ্চলে প্রসারিত হচ্ছে এবং অন্য প্রায় সবকিছুতে স্কেল করছে। ️
bangla_paragraph4: সাত বছরেরও বেশি সময় ধরে, গ্রোথ ফান্ডটি ১০০ টিরও বেশি সংস্থায় বিনিয়োগ করেছে, ডেভিড জর্জ, একজন সাধারণ অংশীদার যিনি গ্রোথে বিনিয়োগ দলের নেতৃত্ব দেন, তার ঘোষণা ব্লগে লিখেছেন। কিন্তু এই এআই যুগে, সংস্থাগুলি দ্রুত বৃদ্ধি পর্যায়ে পৌঁছেছে এবং আগের চেয়েও উচ্চতর মূল্যায়নে আরও বেশি নগদ গ্রাস করছে। এই বিলিয়নগুলির সাথে, এ 16 জেড এন্টারপ্রাইজ এবং ভোক্তা এআই প্রযুক্তি, প্রতিরক্ষা প্রযুক্তি, রোবোটিক্স, অবকাঠামোগত হার্ডওয়্যার এবং সফ্টওয়্যার, এবং স্বাস্থ্য প্রযুক্তি  সত্যিই পুরো স্ট্যাকটি অনুসরণ করছে।
bangla_paragraph5: এই নির্বাচনের বছরে, এটি রাজনীতি এবং লবিতেও প্রচুর ব্যয় করছে। এই নতুন তহবিলগুলি জানুয়ারিতে ঘোষণা করা 15 বিলিয়ন ডলারের নতুন তত্ত্বাবধানে অনুসরণ করে। সেই সময়ে, এটির পরিচালনায় 90 বিলিয়ন ডলার সম্পদ ছিল।

title: The Google TV Streamer now costs $50 more
title_bn: গুগল টিভি স্ট্রিমার এখন ৫০ ডলার বেশি খরচ করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google raised the price of its 4K streaming box to $149, up $50 from its original $99 price. The new price is currently live at the Google Store and Best Buy, but Amazon appears to still be offering the original price. The price hike comes just a cou
paragraph1: Skip to main contentGoogle’s streaming device is the latest to get a price hike, after similar increases from Apple and Amazon.Google’s streaming device is the latest to get a price hike, after similar increases from Apple and Amazon.by Stevie BonifieldAug 31, 2026, 10:32 PM UTCPhoto by Chris Welch / The VergeStevie Bonifield is a news writer covering all things consumer tech.
paragraph2: Stevie started out at Laptop Mag writing news and reviews on hardware, gaming, and AI.Google raised the price of its 4K streaming box to $149, up $50 from its original $99 price. The new price is currently live at the Google Store and Best Buy, but Amazon appears to still be offering the original price.
paragraph3: The price hike comes just a couple of weeks after Google launched its new lineup of Pixel 11 phones with a $100 price hike over their Pixel 10 counterparts.The Google TV Streamer originally launched in 2024 and doubles as a smart home hub. It isn’t the only streaming device getting more expensive — component shortages have been driving up prices on everything from laptops to game consoles.
paragraph4: Earlier this month, Amazon increased the price of its Fire TV Stick 4K Max by over 40 percent to $84.99. The Apple TV 4K also similarly costs more after Apple’s sweeping price hikes in June, bringing it up to $199 for the 64GB version and $249 for the 128GB version.

bangla_paragraph1: গুগলের স্ট্রিমিং ডিভাইসটি অ্যাপল এবং অ্যামাজনের অনুরূপ মূল্যবৃদ্ধির পরে সর্বশেষতম মূল্যবৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: স্টিভি ল্যাপটপ ম্যাগ এ হার্ডওয়্যার, গেমিং এবং এআই সম্পর্কে সংবাদ এবং পর্যালোচনা লেখার শুরু করেছিলেন। গুগল তার 4K স্ট্রিমিং বাক্সের দাম 149 ডলারে উন্নীত করেছে, যা মূল 99 ডলারের থেকে 50 ডলার বেশি। নতুন দামটি বর্তমানে গুগলের স্টোর এবং সেরা কিনতে লাইভ রয়েছে, তবে অ্যামাজন এখনও মূল দাম দিচ্ছে বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
bangla_paragraph3: গুগল তাদের পিক্সেল ১০ প্রতিপক্ষের তুলনায় ১০০ ডলারের দাম বাড়িয়ে পিক্সল ১১ ফোনের নতুন লাইনআপ চালু করার মাত্র কয়েক সপ্তাহ পরেই এই মূল্যবৃদ্ধি ঘটেছে। গুগলের টিভি স্ট্রিমার মূলত ২০২৪ সালে চালু হয়েছিল এবং এটি স্মার্ট হোম হাব হিসাবে দ্বিগুণ। এটি একমাত্র স্ট্রিমিং ডিভাইস নয় যা আরও ব্যয়বহুল হচ্ছে  উপাদানগুলির ঘাটতি ল্যাপটপ থেকে গেম কনসোল পর্যন্ত সমস্ত কিছুর দাম বাড়াচ্ছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এই মাসের শুরুর দিকে, অ্যামাজন তার ফায়ার টিভি স্টিক 4K ম্যাক্সের দাম ৪০ শতাংশেরও বেশি করে ৮৪.৯৯ ডলারে বাড়িয়েছে। অ্যাপল  এর জুনে ব্যাপক মূল্যবৃদ্ধির পরে অ্যাপল টিভি 4 কেও একইভাবে বেশি খরচ করে, এটি 64 গিগাবাইট সংস্করণের জন্য 199 ডলার এবং 128 গিগাবিট সংস্করণের 249 ডলার পর্যন্ত নিয়ে আসে।
bangla_paragraph5: আপনার ব্যক্তিগতকৃত হোমপেজে এই গল্পের মতো আরও কিছু দেখতে এবং ইমেইল আপডেট পেতে এই গল্প থেকে বিষয় এবং লেখকদের অনুসরণ করুন।

title: A group funded by Andreessen, Horowitz, and Brockman plans data center ads to sway midterms
title_bn: অ্যান্ড্রেসেন, হরোভিটজ এবং ব্রকম্যানের অর্থায়নে একটি গ্রুপ মিড-টেমসকে প্রভাবিত করার জন্য ডেটা সেন্টারের বিজ্ঞাপন পরিকল্পনা করছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Build American AI plans to lobby voters in select states about the virtues of data centers by spending millions of dollars on ads.
paragraph1: A well-known, pro-AI super political action committee is behind a new group that plans to blast voters in key battleground states with ads advocating for data centers, several outlets are reporting. That new group, called Build American AI, wants to convince citizens of the virtues of having data centers in their backyards. It says it is affiliated with Leading the Future (LTF), a super PAC heavily funded by VCs Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, along with OpenAI President Greg Brockman. Build American AI told Bloomberg it will focus its ads on Kansas, Ohio, and Wisconsin, where concerns about data centers have become a central theme in statewide elections.
paragraph2: It said its ad budget is millions of dollars. LTF launched with over $50 million in funding and has mostly used that money to donate to specific politicians, Politico reports. It supports candidates who advocate for AI, but it also works to oppose candidates who lobby against the technology, sources have told Politico. LTF has become such a well-known, and not particularly beloved, force in AI-related election politics that OpenAI publicly distanced itself from it in a blog post in June.
paragraph3: “There have been questions around Leading the Future (LTF), which has received support from our President and co-founder, Greg Brockman, and his wife Anna,” OpenAI wrote. “OpenAI does not direct the activities of LTF, or have visibility into their operations.” OpenAI also condemned some of LTF’s tactics, writing: “Groups that are advocating on AI should be clear about their policy views, be honest about whom they represent, and not use tactics like astroturfing that obscure the real choices facing policymakers and the public.” (Astroturfing means making a paid, organized campaign look like grassroots support.)
paragraph4: While LTF has gained attention in Silicon Valley, it is not the only super PAC pushing an AI agenda that is backed by big Valley names. Anthropic, for instance, is a known supporter of Public First Action, a group that backs AI regulation. Meanwhile, Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz have been “spending on politics like no other” as The New York Times put it. By the outlet’s calculations, their venture firm, Andreessen Horowitz, is the biggest donor so far to the midterm elections, spending more than high-profile donors like Elon Musk and George Soros.
paragraph5: The firm has spread over $115 million around so far in disclosed federal contributions. In addition to LTF and AI causes, it is also heavily supporting pro-crypto efforts, especially through the crypto super PAC Fairshake. bangla_paragraph1: একটি সুপরিচিত, এআই-সমর্থিত সুপার রাজনৈতিক কর্ম কমিটি একটি নতুন গ্রুপের পিছনে রয়েছে যা ডেটা সেন্টারের পক্ষে প্রচার করে বিজ্ঞাপন দিয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রের রাজ্যগুলিতে ভোটারদের বিস্ফোরণে ফেলার পরিকল্পনা করছে, বেশ কয়েকটি আউটলেট রিপোর্ট করছে। বিল্ড আমেরিকান এআই নামে এই নতুন গ্রুপ নাগরিকদের তাদের পিছনের উঠোনে ডেটা কেন্দ্র থাকার গুণাবলী সম্পর্কে বিশ্বাস করতে চায়। এটি বলে যে এটি লিডিং দ্য ফিউচার (এলটিএফ) এর সাথে যুক্ত, ভিসি মার্ক আন্দ্রেসেন এবং বেন হরোভিটস, ওপেনএআই প্রেসিডেন্ট গ্রেগ ব্রকম্যানের সাথে একত্রে একটি সুপার পিএসি। বিল্ট এ
bangla_paragraph2: এটি বলেছে যে এর বিজ্ঞাপন বাজেট লক্ষ লক্ষ ডলার। এলটিএফ 50 মিলিয়ন ডলারেরও বেশি তহবিল দিয়ে চালু হয়েছিল এবং বেশিরভাগ অর্থ নির্দিষ্ট রাজনীতিবিদদের দান করার জন্য ব্যবহার করেছে, পলিটিকো রিপোর্ট করেছে। এটি এআইয়ের পক্ষে যারা প্রার্থী সমর্থন করে তাদের সমর্থন করে, তবে এটি প্রযুক্তির বিরুদ্ধে লবি করার প্রার্থীদের বিরুদ্ধেও কাজ করে, সূত্রগুলি পলিতিকোকে বলেছে। এলএফআই এআই-সম্পর্কিত নির্বাচনী রাজনীতিতে এত সুপরিচিত এবং বিশেষভাবে প্রিয় নয় এমন একটি শক্তি হয়ে উঠেছে যে ওপেনএআই প্রকাশ্যে জুন মাসে একটি ব্লগ পোস্টে এটি থেকে নিজেকে দূরে সরিয়ে নিয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: আমাদের প্রেসিডেন্ট এবং সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা গ্রেগ ব্রকম্যান এবং তার স্ত্রী আনা থেকে সমর্থন পেয়েছে,  ওপেনএআই লিখেছে  পেনএএআই এলটিএফের কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করে না, বা তাদের কার্যক্রমের মধ্যে দৃশ্যমানতা রাখে না।  OpenAI এছাড়াও এলটিএফ এর কিছু কৌশলকে নিন্দা করে লিখেছেঃ এআই-র পক্ষে কথা বলায় থাকা গোষ্ঠীগুলিকে তাদের নীতিগত মতামত সম্পর্কে পরিষ্কার হওয়া উচিত, তারা কাকে প্রতিনিধিত্ব করে সে সম্পর্কে সৎ হওয়া উচিত এবং প্রকৃত পছন্দগুলিকে অন্ধকার করে এমন অ্যাস্ট্রোটার্ফিংয়ের মতো কৌশল ব্যবহার না করা উচিত।
bangla_paragraph4: যদিও এলটিএফ সিলিকন ভ্যালিতে মনোযোগ অর্জন করেছে, এটি একমাত্র সুপার পিএসি নয় যা একটি এআই এজেন্ডাকে এগিয়ে নিয়ে যায় যা বড় ভ্যালির নামগুলির দ্বারা সমর্থিত। উদাহরণস্বরূপ, অ্যানথ্রপিক পাবলিক ফার্স্ট অ্যাকশনের একটি পরিচিত সমর্থক, একটি গ্রুপ যা এআই নিয়ন্ত্রণকে সমর্থন করে। এদিকে, মার্ক আন্দ্রেসেন এবং বেন হরোভিটস নিউ ইয়র্ক টাইমস হিসাবে অন্য কারও মতো রাজনীতিতে ব্যয় করছে। আউটলেট এর গণনার মতে, তাদের ভেঞ্চার ফার্ম, আন্দ্রেসন হরোভিটস, মধ্যবর্তী নির্বাচনে এখন পর্যন্ত বৃহত্তম দাতা, আরও বেশি ব্যয় করছে
bangla_paragraph5: এই সংস্থাটি এখন পর্যন্ত প্রকাশিত ফেডারেল অবদানগুলিতে প্রায় ১১৫ মিলিয়ন ডলার বিতরণ করেছে। এলটিএফ এবং এআই কারণগুলির পাশাপাশি, এটি বিশেষত ক্রিপ্টো সুপার পিএসি ফেয়ারশেকের মাধ্যমে ক্রিপ্টোগ্রাফির প্রচেষ্টাকেও ব্যাপকভাবে সমর্থন করছে। আপনি যখন আমাদের নিবন্ধগুলির লিঙ্কগুলির মাধ্যমে ক্রয় করেন, আমরা একটি ছোট কমিশন উপার্জন করতে পারি। এটি আমাদের সম্পাদকীয় স্বাধীনতাকে প্রভাবিত করে না।

title: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
title_bn: JMGO এর খুব উজ্জ্বল অল-ইন-ওয়ান প্রজেক্টর গেমার এবং স্পোর্টসের জন্য আদর্শ দেখাচ্ছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: JMGO's 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max all-in-one Google TV projector is now available outside China. It gets its name from a new dual-iris system that lets it produce an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast, according to JMGO. It boosts the contrast - always
paragraph1: Thomas Ricker is a deputy editor and Verge co-founder with a passion for human-centric cities, e-bikes, and life as a digital nomad. He’s been a tech journalist for 20 years.JMGO’s 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max all-in-one Google TV projector is now available outside China. It gets its name from a new dual-iris system that lets it produce an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast, according to JMGO.
paragraph2: It boosts the contrast — always an issue with projectors — by placing two separate physical apertures (irises) along different points of the internal optical path to control light scatter and brightness far more aggressively than a single iris can. It also promises to produce a very bright 6,500 ISO lumen image from its triple-laser light engine.Last year at IFA, 6,000 lumens from an all-in-one projector was breaking new ground. At IFA 2026, it’s shaping up to be table stakes, alongside 4k imagery purring along at a smooth 120Hz for fast-moving sports and gaming.
paragraph3: Just note that I found JMGO’s N3 Ultimate to be unwatchable at peak brightness due to color distortion — so best wait for the reviews on this one.Like that previous flagship, the new Iris Ultra Max is mounted on a motorized pan-and-tilt gimbal for useful Wiimote-like control. That, combined with an 0.88–1.
paragraph4: 7:1 optical zoom and V±130% / H±53% lens shift, gives you unparalleled image placement options that also preserve optical image quality.JGMO’s also tossing in VRR and ALLM to keep latency low and reduce tearing when gaming on the IRIS Ultra Max, with support for Dolby Vision HDR at 4K 120Hz.
