title: Thank You, Sponsors, For Powering Inc42’s D2C & Retail Summit 2026
title_bn: Thank You, Sponsors, For Powering Inc42’s D2C & Retail Summit 2026
author: TechPulse
excerpt: As India’s D2C and retail ecosystem enters the era of D2C 3.0, Inc42’s flagship, The D2C & Retail Summit, continues…
paragraph1: As India’s D2C and retail ecosystem enters the era of D2C 3.0, Inc42’s flagship, The D2C & Retail Summit, continues to bring the country’s sharpest founders, operators, investors, and enablers into one room to decode what it takes to build enduring consumer brands. Over the past seven editions, Inc42 has closely tracked this ecosystem through in-depth reporting, data-led research, cohort-based learning programmes and marquee summits, chronicling how brands move from early traction to scale while navigating shifting capital cycles, quick-commerce economics and evolving consumer expectations. This August, Inc42 brought together this ecosystem at the seventh edition of The D2C & Retail Summit, held on 19th August 2026 at The Leela Ambience, Gurugram, under the theme ‘Commerce In The Age Of AI & 10-Min Delivery.’ The invite-only summit convened 600+ founders, CXOs, investors and operators, selected from 2,000+ applications, with 70%+ of attendees being founders themselves. The agenda featured 15+ high-impact sessions and 5 hands-on workshops, alongside 60+ speakers spanning legacy brands, new-age disruptors, investors and commerce enablers. Over half the brands represented were at ₹15 Cr+ ARR, with Fashion & Accessories and F&B leading the mix, alongside beauty & personal care, electronics, home and retail. The summit also featured 27 booths showcasing brands across categories.
paragraph2: The day’s marquee conversations included boAt cofounder Aman Gupta in an unfiltered AMA on building consumer brands and his new venture OFF/BEAT; Veeba founder and MD Viraj Bahl on scaling the sauces major to a ₹1,000 Cr+ FMCG engine; Snitch founder Siddharth Dungarwal on How Speed, Stores & Community Built A Cult Menswear Brand; Manyavar-Mohey CRO Vedant Modi on phygital retail; and Agilitas Sports cofounder Abhishek Ganguly on India’s sportswear opportunity. Investors including Manu Chandra of Sauce.vc, Archana Jahagirdar of Rukam Capital, Aditya Singh of All In Capital and Kannan Sitaram of Fireside Ventures also came together to discuss where consumer capital is headed next. In a fireside chat, Veeba’s Bahl said quick commerce can grow alongside other distribution channels, creating broader momentum for emerging consumer brands. “Quick commerce entered Veeba’s journey relatively late but has since emerged as an important revenue channel and growth driver for the sauce and condiment maker,” Bahl said. Meanwhile, Vedant Fashions’ Modi shared how data and AI are becoming central to how Manyavar-Mohey makes retail decisions. According to Modi, data helps the brand decide which products should go to which stores, move inventory based on local demand, and protect its premium pricing as it scales. “Our overall growth is being driven by our ability to turn data into decisions — from product design and inventory allocation to store-level performance,” Modi said.
paragraph3: Across panels and workshops, speakers unpacked themes ranging from quick commerce margins and distribution moats to agentic commerce, export economics, and AI-led brand building. But none of these insightful dialogues would have been possible without the support of our sponsors and partners, who helped make The Inc42 D2C & Retail Summit 2026 into a platform for meaningful dialogue and ecosystem-level impact. Presenting Partner PhonePe Payment Gateway PhonePe Payment Gateway is the merchant payments arm of PhonePe, India’s leading digital payments major, enabling businesses to accept payments seamlessly across cards, UPI, net banking, wallets and BNPL. With a strong focus on speed, reliability and high-conversion checkout experiences, PhonePe Payment Gateway helps D2C and retail brands meet the default expectation of seamless commerce, powering payment acceptance at scale for businesses across categories. Kamal Lochan Das, business head, PhonePe Payment Gateway, joined a panel discussion titled ‘What Do India’s Shopping Patterns Reveal About The Next Growth Wave?‘, alongside Akash Agrawalla, cofounder of D2C spice brand ZOFF Foods; Ayush Bansal, director at Liberty Shoes; and was moderated by Karan Saraf of PwC India. During the discussion, Das pointed to a shift in how Indian consumers approach digital payments, moving from a purely utility-led mindset to increasingly discretionary spending, as part of the broader convenience-led consumption wave reshaping Indian retail. Co-Presenting Partners Shadowfax Shadowfax is a last-mile and hyperlocal logistics major, with a nationwide network spanning over 14,700 pin codes across first-mile, last-mile and sort centres.
paragraph4: It serves ecommerce, quick commerce, food delivery and on-demand mobility clients, offering express parcel delivery alongside reverse pickups, exchanges and same-day delivery. The company listed on the NSE and BSE in January 2026. RECOMMENDED FOR yOU During the summit, Shadowfax cofounder and CEO Abhishek Bansal moderated a fireside session with Agilitas Sports cofounder and CEO Abhishek Ganguli, titled ‘The $1 Bn Sportswear Bet: Building India’s Sportswear House.’ The conversation covered how Agilitas is building an integrated sportswear business, spanning athlete-led brands like One8 and Mochiko’s manufacturing depth to its retail and channel strategy, as it works towards building India’s own globally competitive sportswear house. Glance Glance, part of the InMobi Group, is an AI-native content and commerce platform that turns lock screens and connected devices into discovery surfaces. Through personalised, shoppable content delivered at scale, Glance is helping brands reach consumers at moments of high intent, extending discovery and commerce beyond the traditional app and website funnel. Piyush Shah, cofounder of InMobi and Glance, joined a fireside chat titled ‘How Agentic Commerce Will Change The Way India Shops,‘ alongside The Bear House cofounder Harsh Somaiya and Inc42 cofounder and CEO Vaibhav Vardhan. Explaining the premise behind agentic commerce, Shah said, “Consumers no longer need to navigate every stage of the purchase journey, a shift Glance is betting on through its AI shopping agent, which uses signals like a consumer’s preferences, budget, context and appearance to recommend products, create complete looks and enable virtual try-ons.
paragraph5: ” Powered By Partners Gupshup Gupshup is a global conversational engagement platform that helps businesses build AI-led messaging experiences across WhatsApp, RCS and other channels. Its tools enable D2C brands to run conversational commerce, marketing and support at scale, turning routine customer touchpoints into revenue and retention opportunities. Adwit Sharma, senior director – presales & solutions, Gupshup.ai, was also part of a DRS 2026 panel discussion titled ‘Turning One-Time Buyers Into Repeat Customers,’ where he spoke about moving conversations beyond customer support to discovery, education, reactivation and loyalty, and building AI-led conversational flows for recommendations, replenishment nudges and human escalation. Elements Wellness Elements Wellness is the flagship wellness brand of Indiashoppe, bringing together Ayurvedic formulations with modern research, quality manufacturing and scalable distribution. Since its 2014 launch, it has grown into one of India’s fastest-expanding wellness brands, with a presence across 750+ distribution centres and a growing digital education push for its distributor network. Rajesh Chandan, founder of Elements Wellness, was also part of a panel discussion titled ‘Growth Without The Burn: Engineering Profitable Growth,’ where he spoke about moving from GMV-led growth to margin quality and capital-efficient scale, and building repeat cohorts and owned customer relationships as acquisition costs rise. NITRO Nitro is a revenue-as-a-service full-stack platform for ecommerce, D2C and retail brands, built to solve acquisition and retention bottlenecks with technology.

excerpt: The end of an era is upon us, as Tim Cook will be stepping down as Apple's CEO on September 1, after 15 years of leading the company. Cook has been Apple's CEO since 2011 Tomorrow, Apple's hardware engineering chief John Ternus will become the compan
paragraph1: The end of an era is upon us, as Tim Cook will be stepping down as Apple's CEO on September 1, after 15 years of leading the company. Cook has been Apple's CEO since 2011Tomorrow, Apple's hardware engineering chief John Ternus will become the company's next CEO. Cook will remain at Apple as the executive chairman of the company's board of directors. In this new role, Apple said Cook will assist with "certain aspects" of the company, including "engaging with policymakers around the world." Cook became Apple's CEO in August 2011, after Steve Jobs stepped down due to health problems.
paragraph2: Under his leadership, Apple became the world's most valuable company on multiple occasions, and it launched products and services such as the Apple Watch, AirPods, HomePod, Vision Pro, Apple Music, Apple TV, and much more. Apple has set all-time quarterly revenue records over its past few quarters, so the company is in a strong financial position as Cook hands the reins to Ternus. Ternus (left) and Cook (right)"It has been the greatest privilege of my life to be the CEO of Apple and to have been trusted to lead such an extraordinary company," said Cook. "I love Apple with all of my being, and I am so grateful to have had the opportunity to work with a team of such ingenious, innovative, creative, and deeply caring people who have been unwavering in their dedication to enriching the lives of our customers and creating the best products and services in the world." "John Ternus has the mind of an engineer, the soul of an innovator, and the heart to lead with integrity and with honor," said Cook.
paragraph3: "He is a visionary whose contributions to Apple over 25 years are already too numerous to count, and he is without question the right person to lead Apple into the future." "I am filled with optimism about what we can achieve in the years to come, and I am so happy to know that the most talented people on earth are here at Apple, determined to be part of something bigger than any one of us," said Ternus. title: PhonePe Launches UPI Payments For Feature Phones
title_bn: PhonePe Launches UPI Payments For Feature Phones
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Walmart-owned fintech major PhonePe has launched UPI payments for feature phones, mobile phones that handle basic calling and text messaging,…
paragraph1: SUMMARYPhonePe has launched UPI payments for feature phones to make digital transactions without requiring an internet connection To foray into this space, PhonePe had acquired Gupshup’s proprietary technology GSPay in June 2025, to launch its own UPI-based payment solution for feature phones The company said that its new service, dubbed PhonePe UPI 123Pay, will bring UPI capabilities to more than 20 Cr feature phone users in the country Walmart-owned fintech major PhonePe has launched UPI payments for feature phones, mobile phones that handle basic calling and text messaging, enabling them to make digital transactions without requiring an internet connection. With the launch, PhonePe claimed to have become the first major third-party application provider (TPAP) to extend UPI payments to feature phone users at scale. The company said that its new service, dubbed PhonePe UPI 123Pay, will bring UPI capabilities to more than 20 Cr feature phone users in the country. The service will come pre-installed on feature phones manufactured by Nokia, HMD, Lava International and Itel Mobile, which is owned by Transsion Holdings. PhonePe said it plans to add more handset partners in the coming months. PhonePe UPI 123Pay uses an SMS-based architecture, processing transactions in areas with limited 2G connectivity.
paragraph2: Users will be able to make P2P (peer-to-peer) transfers using mobile numbers or UPI IDs and pay merchants through UPI IDs and QR codes on camera-enabled devices. To help users activate the service, PhonePe has also launched a voice-first, AI-powered helpline that offers assistance in English and 12 Indian languages. Users can register for the service directly on compatible feature phones by selecting their bank, entering the last six digits and expiry date of their debit card, and setting a UPI PIN. “Bringing UPI to feature phones through PhonePe UPI 123Pay extends the benefits of digital payments beyond smartphones to every corner of the country,” said Sameer Nigam, founder and CEO of PhonePe. For context, the RBI announced the introduction of UPI123Pay, the offline version of UPI in 2022. UPI123Pay works primarily on IVR technology, and the process is automated in terms of carrying out transactions.
paragraph3: To foray into this space, PhonePe had acquired Gupshup’s proprietary technology GSPay in June 2025. Back then, it had revealed plans to customise the freshly bought GSPay IP to launch its own UPI-based payment solution for feature phones. The launch comes as digital payment companies look to expand UPI adoption beyond smartphone users, particularly in rural and semi-urban parts of the country where smartphone penetration and reliable internet connectivity remain inconsistent. Meanwhile, UPI transaction volume rose 4% to 23.66 Bn in July from 22.72 Bn in June, as per data released by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), of which PhonePe and Google Pay continue to dominate the UPI ecosystem.
paragraph4: PhonePe processed the highest 1,085.8 Cr transactions worth ₹14.4 Lakh Cr during the month. PhonePe filed the updated draft red herring prospectus (UDRHP) with SEBI for its IPO in January this year. However, it paused its public listing plans in the months that followed, stating volatility in the global equity markets. The fintech major’s net loss widened by 62% in FY26 to ₹2,792 Cr from ₹1,727.
paragraph5: 4 Cr reported in the previous fiscal year. Operating revenue rose 11.5% to ₹7,920.5 Cr in the year under review from ₹7,105 Cr in FY25.

title: Key Nvidia and Intel supplier raided over alleged China origin fraud — Unimicron faces probe over PCB origin washing, risk of 40% U.S. tariff penalty
title_bn: Key Nvidia and Intel supplier raided over alleged China origin fraud — Unimicron faces probe over PCB origin washing, risk of 40% U.S. tariff penalty
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Taiwanese prosecutors are investigating Unimicron, one of the world’s largest PCB and chip substrate makers and a key supplier to Nvidia, Intel, Google, and Amazon, over allegations that it shipped China-made PCBs back to Taiwan and relabeled them as
paragraph1: (Image credit: Pine64) Taiwanese prosecutors are investigating Unimicron, one of the world’s largest PCB and chip substrate makers and a key supplier to Nvidia, Intel, Google, and Amazon, over allegations that it shipped China-made PCBs back to Taiwan and relabeled them as Taiwanese products, according to Nikkei Asia. Investigators raided the company’s headquarters in Taoyuan’s Guishan District and a manufacturing plant in Zhongli District on August 28, questioning 14 employees as suspects — including the general and deputy general managers of its PCB business — and four more people as witnesses.Prosecutors say that the alleged conduct contravened Articles 216, 210, and 255 of Taiwan’s Criminal Code, which cover the use of forged private documents and false labeling of an item’s origin. Wang, the person identified as the PCB department general manager, was released on bail of NT$15 million (roughly $473,000), while a deputy general manager identified as Wu was released on NT$12 million (roughly $378,000).Three others are said to have posted bail ranging from NT$300,000 to NT$5 million, and the remaining nine were released without bail. "There was strong suspicion that they had violated Taiwan's law covering the use of forged private documents and false labeling of goods," the Taoyuan District Prosecutors Office said in a statement.
paragraph2: Unimicron told the Taiwan stock exchange that it’s fully cooperating with the investigation and that it doesn’t expect a material impact on its operations.Since August last year, U.S. Customs and Border Protection has applied an additional 40% tariff on goods that it determines were transshipped through third countries to evade duties, on top of any other applicable penalties, and the agency has no authority to waive or otherwise mitigate the charge. If any relabeled Unimicron PCBs were to reach the U.S.
paragraph3: , that penalty would fall on the company’s American customers as importers of record.The White House has identified 40 countries and territories that it says pose an elevated risk of illegal transshipment, with Taiwan flagged as a key concern. Taipei has been running major crackdowns on “origin washing,” where companies claim goods are made in Taiwan to obtain preferential tariff treatment, a crackdown that’s perhaps perfectly illustrated by the fact that prosecutors published names and bail amounts within 24 hours of raiding one of the country’s most important listed tech companies. After all, the “Made in Taiwan” label is ultimately a trade asset whose value rests on the fact that it’s not “Made in China.” Since its elevated risk designation, Taiwan is understandably keen to show Washington that it polices the difference itself rather than leaving it to U.S.
paragraph4: Customs.The products involved in this crackdown appear to be conventional PCBs, not the high-end ABF substrates used for Intel’s EMIB-T platform or Nvidia’s advanced data center accelerators. Unimicron’s offshore manufacturing remains in China for standard substrates, PCBs, HDI, and flexible boards, while its advanced CoWoS-related substrate capacity is based at its Yangmei factory in Taoyuan.If the case concerns relabeling on individual products, the fallout will be limited to the Taiwanese prosecution. If, however, it turns out that China-made goods were transshipped through Taiwan to alter their origin before export to the U.S.
paragraph5: , that’s an entirely different story and could trigger CBP’s 40% transshipment penalty on the affected goods, along with potential retroactive duty reassessments, which would hit Unimicron’s American customers as importers of record.Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox. Luke James is a freelance writer and journalist. Although his background is in legal, he has a personal interest in all things tech, especially hardware and microelectronics, and anything regulatory.

title: How India won over Tim Cook and became central to Apple's growth chapter
title_bn: How India won over Tim Cook and became central to Apple's growth chapter
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Over the past decade, Tim Cook turned a notoriously price-sensitive, Android-dominated market into both a premier manufacturing hub and a record-breaking consumer frontier.
paragraph1: As John Ternus steps in to lead Apple, he inherits more than just the $3-trillion tech empire — a massive advantage built by his predecessor, Tim Cook: India.Cook’s tenure will be remembered for many milestones, but his relentless conviction in India stands out as his most calculated masterstroke.“It (India) is a major focus for us. I was just there, and the dynamism in the market, the vibrancy, is unbelievable,” Cook said.During Apple’s second quarter 2026 earnings call in April, Cook said, “We've been focused on this for a while. It's the second largest smartphone market in the world and the third largest PC market.”He also said that he is “over the moon excited” about India, characterising the market as a “huge opportunity” for the tech giant.Supply chain pivotOver the past decade, Cook turned a notoriously price-sensitive, Android-dominated market into both a premier manufacturing hub and a record-breaking consumer frontier.When Cook first bet on Indian manufacturing, sceptics questioned whether local infrastructure could ever replicate Zhengzhou's hyper-efficiency. Today, the results speak for themselves.
paragraph2: “From a pragmatic point of view, you need to produce there to be competitive,” Cook previously noted during an investor interaction, defending the aggressive shift. “We're working on the entire ecosystem from developer to the market to operations... And I could not be more excited and enthusiastic about it.”Driven by New Delhi’s Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme and Apple’s aggressive “China+1” diversification strategy, India has become central to Apple’s hardware output, according to an Economic Times report.In a 2016 interview with NDTV, Cook said India is different from China. “India is a different place, and we are going into India very humbly,” he said. “India is a hugely exciting market for us and is a major focus,” Cook said, noting that India has an enormously bright future and Apple “would like to be a part of that, and we plan to be.”In 2016, critics had alleged that Apple was merely using its certified pre-owned programme to "dump" used devices into the Indian market. However, Cook firmly pushed back and clarified that Apple’s goal was to bring global refurbishment standards directly to India, restoring pre-owned devices locally to factory-grade condition with full warranties.Cook insisted that the initiative was about expanding affordability and setting up domestic refurbishment infrastructure, rejecting any notion of offloading substandard inventory onto Indian consumers.
paragraph3: “We are putting enormous amounts of energy into India. Not here for a quarter, we are here for a thousand years,” he told NDTV. “We're not about making the most of thinking for the long term and never lowering the bar on best, those are the things we are about.”The ET report noted that India now accounts for 25% of global iPhone output, i.e., approximately one in every four iPhones assembled globally. Apple assembled about 55 million iPhones in India in 2025, up from 36 million a year earlier, ET reported.ET said that all versions of the latest iPhone 17 lineup in India, including the high-end Pro and Pro Max models, are being built at Indian assembly lines run by partners like Foxconn and Tata Electronics, in sync with global launch dates.The push, the report said, has expanded well beyond final assembly into component localisation, including lithium-ion cells, watch and phone enclosures and accessories such as AirPods.For Cook, supply chain diversification wasn't merely a risk-mitigation hedge against geopolitical tensions; it was an operational reimagining that insulated Apple's bottom line against single-market disruption.
paragraph4: In April 2023, Apple opened its first company-owned stores in India, building on the company's 25-year history in the country. Cook personally inaugurated Apple’s first company-owned flagship stores: Apple BKC in Mumbai and Apple Saket in New Delhi.“India is at a tipping point. title: Foldcast secures €160K to reduce concrete use with recyclable paper moulds
title_bn: ফোল্ডকাস্ট পুনর্ব্যবহারযোগ্য কাগজের ছাঁচ দিয়ে কংক্রিট ব্যবহার হ্রাস করতে € 160K সুরক্ষিত করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Swissconstruction technology startup Foldcast has secured €160,000 (CHF 150,000) fromVenture Kick to advance its recyclable paper mould technology for concreteconstruction and move towards commercial ...
paragraph1: Swiss construction technology startup Foldcast has secured €160,000 (CHF 150,000) from Venture Kick to advance its recyclable paper mould technology for concrete construction and move towards commercial deployment. A spin-off from Università della Svizzera italiana (USI), Foldcast was founded by Fabio Amicarelli and Ena Lloret-Fritschi to develop a construction method combining recyclable paper-based moulds with design software and digital manufacturing to produce material-efficient concrete elements. The company is addressing the environmental impact and material inefficiencies associated with conventional concrete construction.
paragraph2: Concrete is estimated to account for around eight per cent of global CO₂ emissions, while traditional wood and metal formwork can limit the production of structurally optimised shapes and add to construction costs. Foldcast uses flexible paper moulds to produce customised concrete elements, allowing material to be placed where structurally needed. Its software supports the design and optimisation of structural components, while digital manufacturing is used to produce the corresponding formwork.
paragraph3: The company says the approach can reduce material consumption and associated emissions while maintaining structural performance. Foldcast is initially targeting sustainability-focused real estate developers and institutional asset owners in Switzerland and other European markets. In the longer term, the company plans to work with precast concrete manufacturers as production and licensing partners.
paragraph4: The new funding will support Foldcast's transition from technology validation to market entry. The company plans to complete two pilot projects, develop a minimum viable product for its software, establish industrial production partnerships in Switzerland and strengthen its sales and business development activities.
bangla_paragraph1: সুইস নির্মাণ প্রযুক্তি স্টার্টআপ ফোল্ডকাস্ট বেকনোট নির্মাণের জন্য তার পুনর্ব্যবহারযোগ্য কাগজ ছাঁচ প্রযুক্তিকে এগিয়ে নিতে এবং বাণিজ্যিক প্রয়োগের দিকে এগিয়ে যাওয়ার জন্য ভেঞ্চার কিক থেকে 160,000 ইউরো (150,000 CHF) সুরক্ষিত করেছে। ফ্যাবিও অ্যামিকারেলি এবং এনা লোরেট-ফ্রিটচি দ্বারা প্রতিষ্ঠিত, ফোলডকাস্টটি একটি নির্মাণ পদ্ধতি তৈরি করতে তৈরি করা হয়েছিল যা পুনর্বিবেচনাযোগ্য কাগজের ভিত্তিক ছাঁচের সাথে ডিজাইন সফ্টওয়্যার এবং ডিজিটাল উত্পাদনকে একত্রিত করে উপাদান-কার্যকর কংক্রিট ইলে
bangla_paragraph2: কংক্রিট বিশ্বব্যাপী CO2 নির্গমনের প্রায় আট শতাংশের জন্য দায়ী বলে অনুমান করা হয়, যখন ঐতিহ্যগত কাঠ এবং ধাতব ফর্মওয়ার্ক কাঠামোগতভাবে অনুকূলিত আকারের উত্পাদনকে সীমাবদ্ধ করতে পারে এবং নির্মাণ ব্যয়কে যুক্ত করতে পারে। ফোল্ডকাস্ট কাস্টমাইজড কংক্রোট উপাদান উত্পন্ন করতে নমনীয় কাগজের ছাঁচ ব্যবহার করে, কাঠামেন্টের প্রয়োজনের জায়গায় উপাদান স্থাপন করার অনুমতি দেয়। এর সফ্টওয়্যার কাঠামের উপাদানগুলির নকশা এবং অনুকূলকরণকে সমর্থন করে, যখন ডিজিটাল উত্পাদন সংশ্লিষ্ট ফর্মওয়ার তৈরি করতে ব্যবহৃত হয়।
bangla_paragraph3: কোম্পানিটি বলেছে যে এই পদ্ধতিটি কাঠামোগত কর্মক্ষমতা বজায় রেখে উপাদান খরচ এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট নির্গমন হ্রাস করতে পারে। ফোল্ডকাস্ট প্রাথমিকভাবে সুইজারল্যান্ড এবং অন্যান্য ইউরোপীয় বাজারে টেকসইতা-কেন্দ্রিক রিয়েল এস্টেট ডেভেলপার এবং প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক সম্পদ মালিকদের লক্ষ্যবস্তু করছে। দীর্ঘমেয়াদে, কোম্পানি উৎপাদন এবং লাইসেন্সিং অংশীদার হিসাবে প্রিফ্যাক্ট কংক্রিট নির্মাতাদের সাথে কাজ করার পরিকল্পনা করছে।
bangla_paragraph4: নতুন অর্থায়নটি ফোল্ডকাস্টের প্রযুক্তির বৈধতা থেকে বাজারে প্রবেশের দিকে রূপান্তরকে সমর্থন করবে। কোম্পানি দুটি পাইলট প্রকল্প সম্পন্ন করার পরিকল্পনা করেছে, তার সফ্টওয়্যারটির জন্য একটি ন্যূনতম কার্যকর পণ্য বিকাশ করবে, সুইজারল্যান্ডে শিল্প উৎপাদন অংশীদারিত্ব স্থাপন করবে এবং তার বিক্রয় এবং ব্যবসায়িক উন্নয়ন কার্যক্রমকে শক্তিশালী করবে।

title: Centre Notifies ₹1.28 Lakh Cr Semicon 2.0, Targets 1 Lakh More Chip Engineers
title_bn: Centre Notifies ₹1.28 Lakh Cr Semicon 2.0, Targets 1 Lakh More Chip Engineers
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The Centre has notified the ₹1.28 Lakh Cr Semicon 2.0 scheme to accelerate the development of India’s semiconductor design and…
paragraph1: SUMMARYCentre has notified the ₹1.28 Lakh Cr Semicon 2.0 scheme, with the IT ministry setting a target of developing 1 Lakh additional semiconductor engineers The scheme expands India’s semiconductor push beyond fabs to chip design, packaging, R&D, equipment, materials and talent, strengthening domestic capabilities, and reducing reliance on global supply chains The scheme covers six key areas, offers up to ₹15 Cr seed funding for eligible semiconductor startups and MSMEs, provides fiscal support for fabs and advanced packaging, and prioritises around 100 chips across compute, memory, RF, power, networking and sensors The Centre has notified the ₹1.28 Lakh Cr Semicon 2.0 scheme to accelerate the development of India’s semiconductor design and manufacturing ecosystem and strengthen domestic capabilities across the chip value chain. The notification comes more than a month after the Union Cabinet approved the second phase of the India Semiconductor Mission with an exact outlay of ₹1,27,500 Cr. Semicon 2.0 was first announced by finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman in the Union Budget for FY27. “Semicon 2.0 provides fiscal support to various verticals across the complete value chain of the semiconductor industry, ranging from chip design, fabrication and packaging to various segments of the semiconductor ecosystem,” the notification said. The scheme has been divided into six pillars covering semiconductor design, machines and materials, fabs, assembly and packaging, R&D, and talent development.
paragraph2: These pillars encompass 10 categories of support. The scheme aims to build a strong, trusted and self-reliant semiconductor ecosystem in India by supporting the development and use of technologies for critical and strategic infrastructure. Under the design component, the government will support the development of semiconductor IP cores, chips, system-on-chips (SoCs) and modules for electronic products based on national priorities and strategic needs. The government also plans to develop standard IP building blocks for areas such as computing, memory, radio frequency (RF), power, networking and sensors, the notification said. Support Across Semiconductor Value Chain Semicon 2.0 extends government support beyond chip fabrication to the infrastructure and capabilities needed to build a domestic semiconductor ecosystem. The scheme provides support for semiconductor equipment and materials, wafer fabrication, assembly, testing, marking and packaging (ATMP), outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT), as well as semiconductor research and development and talent development. For semiconductor design, eligible startups and MSMEs can receive seed funding of up to ₹15 Cr. The scheme also provides equity co-investment support for eligible companies that have raised funding from VC or PE investors. The government will also provide deployment-linked incentives for eligible semiconductor IPs, chips and SoCs launched for the first time after the scheme’s announcement. Semicon 2.
paragraph3: 0 also provides fiscal support for setting up semiconductor fabs and advanced packaging facilities, alongside manufacturing infrastructure for semiconductor equipment and materials. Silicon wafer fabs with a minimum capital investment of ₹20,000 Cr will be eligible for government support equivalent to 40% of eligible capital expenditure. Compound semiconductor, photonics, sensor and discrete semiconductor fabs will also receive fiscal support under the scheme. Advanced semiconductor packaging projects, including 2.5D and 3D packaging, wafer-level chip-scale packaging and heterogeneous integration, will also qualify for government support. The scheme further provides support for R&D facilities focused on semiconductor equipment, semiconductor-grade raw materials, and testing and characterisation infrastructure. Semicon 2.0 To Build Domestic Chip Capabilities The government is also looking to strengthen India’s semiconductor R&D, design capabilities and talent pool under Semicon 2.0. The scheme will support research in advanced technologies such as CMOS fabrication, silicon photonics, display fabrication and chiplets, while also providing access to advanced design tools, fabrication services and training infrastructure. Speaking at a press conference after the scheme was notified, IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said India aims to develop 1 Lakh additional semiconductor engineers under the programme, citing an expected global shortage of about 1 Mn workers by 2032.
paragraph4: “Now, we have set up a target of developing 1 Lakh more engineers,” Vaishnaw said. India has already trained 85,000 semiconductor engineers, achieving its 10-year target in four years. “People should feel dependent on India. People should become dependent on our country, on our industry, on our production, on our design,” Vaishnaw said. Semiconductor design programmes have also been expanded to 355 universities, including those in Tier II and III cities. Students have so far designed 255 chips, the minister said. The programme has identified six key semiconductor categories — compute, memory, radio frequency (RF), power, networking and sensors — with around 100 chips prioritised for development. These chips are expected to cater to sectors such as aviation, transportation, consumer electronics and strategic industries. The notification builds on the first phase of the India Semiconductor Mission, under which the Centre approved 12 manufacturing projects across six states. The push comes as major economies ramp up support for their semiconductor industries. According to data presented by the government, the US has announced a support of $52.
paragraph5: 7 Bn under the CHIPS and Science Act, while the European Union has earmarked $49 Bn under the EU CHIPS Act 1.0 and is discussing a further $140 Bn proposal under CHIPS Act 2.0. Japan has announced a $25.7 Bn Semiconductor Strategy, South Korea has committed $23.3 Bn under its Semiconductor Ecosystem Support Package, and Singapore has announced $27.5 Bn under its RIE2030 Strategy. China has committed $47.5 Bn in the third round of its “Big Fund”, taking its cumulative semiconductor fund support to more than $150 Bn since 2014. Taiwan has announced $9.3 Bn under its Chip-based Industrial Innovation Program.

title: China's CXMT beats Western chipmakers to announcement of LPDDR6 mass production — Xiaomi smartphones to debut industry’s first LPDDR6 chips
title_bn: China's CXMT beats Western chipmakers to announcement of LPDDR6 mass production — Xiaomi smartphones to debut industry’s first LPDDR6 chips
author: TechPulse
excerpt: CXMT claims to be the first to mass-produce LPDDR6 memory. Yet, for a niche phone.
paragraph1: (Image credit: Micron) ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) has announced in a social media post that it has started mass production of LPDDR6 memory for a Xiaomi smartphone, Reuters reports. This is not entirely unexpected given the general LPDDR6 mass-production timeline, but the announcement is still surprising because two China-based companies are ahead of industry announcements. Yet, there are caveats.Go deeper with TH Premium: MemoryLPDDR6 is perhaps the most substantial upgrade to the GDDR-class memory ever. Firstly, it uses PAM3 signaling, which encodes 3 bits of information across two symbols, compared with the NRZ signaling used by LPDDR5/LPDDR5X.
paragraph2: Second, the data transfer rate increases to 43.2 GT/s. Third, the reduced I/O width from 32 bits to 24 bits requires rework at both the hardware and software levels.Given the differences between LPDDR5 and LPDDR6, the most important factor here is not exactly LPDDR6 manufacturing, but a broader view.On the one hand, CXMT reached mass production of LPDDR6 roughly at the same time as the established DRAM leaders, meaning it is on par with them, if not ahead.
paragraph3: This marks a substantial change from earlier generations, when Chinese DRAM technology generally lagged considerably behind Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron.On the other hand, reaching mass production does not necessarily mean that CXMT has achieved full technological or manufacturing parity with its larger rivals. The official announcement covers only one smartphone maker and one model, meaning CXMT's LPDD6 still has to pass validation for other handsets and other makers.Still, the significance of CXMT's announcement is hard to understate. CXMT is no longer merely catching up by introducing a new memory generation years after its international competitors.
paragraph4: With LPDDR6, CXMT is entering the market during the standard's initial commercialization, which means the technology gap between China's leading DRAM producer and the industry's established players has narrowed considerably.Which brings us to the question of whether CXMT can maintain this pace. Built on Ather’s new EL platform, the Konarc will be available across the S and Z product lines, with claimed IDC range options between 100 km and 200 km. The company also unveiled an advanced electronic braking system, a 450-watt onboard charger, and other charging and convenience features at the event. title: I tried 2 of the best third-party Android weather apps. Here’s the one I’m sticking with
title_bn: আমি সেরা থার্ড পার্টি অ্যান্ড্রয়েড আবহাওয়া অ্যাপ্লিকেশন দুই চেষ্টা. এখানে আমি এক সঙ্গে আটকে আছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Breezy or Gradient? This is the one I'd choose.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityI’ll admit that for the last few years, I’ve been pretty lazy about testing new weather apps. I’ve almost exclusively used a combination of Samsung Weather or Pixel Weather alongside AccuWeather. Ready for something new, I decided to dive into the alternatives. What I was looking for was something that bridged the gap between the two services. That meant something easy to jump into, with a fair amount of customization, and a reputation for accuracy.Ultimately, I found two apps that best fit what I was looking for, even though they took somewhat different approaches: Gradient Weather and Breezy Weather. While they both were a dream to use, neither was perfect, but one of these apps ended up winning me over a tad more than the other.Gradient Weather vs Breezy Weather: Which would you pick?4 votesBreezy Weather is a power user’s dream, with one notable flawMegan Ellis / Android AuthorityThere’s a lot to like about the open-source Breezy Weather app, but its privacy-focused nature and customization options are probably at the top of the list. The app gives you a ton of data metrics to choose from, including common ones like the daily and hourly forecast, as well as options like Visibility, Pressure, Sun, and Moon. You might wonder if too much data will result in a cluttered experience, but thankfully, the UI does a great job here. Not only is it easy to get the hang of — since all central data is pretty much in one spot — but it is also presented in a way that doesn’t feel overwhelming or bloated. Speaking of bloat, there are absolutely no ads, trackers, or other similar privacy offenders found in the Breezy App.
paragraph2: There’s also no premium tier, as the app is 100% free. Breezy Weather does a great job of presenting a lot of information in one place without feeling bloated. Those looking for deeper control over their weather data source will be pleased to find they can choose from options such as NWS, AccuWeather, OpenWeather, and a handful of others. It’s not just data, either. You can even customize Breezy’s appearance with optional icon packs.No matter how good a weather app is, we can’t forget about widgets. Breezy Weather does a great job here, with a clean, minimalist approach that will seem familiar if you’re coming from an app like Pixel Weather. As much as I loved Breezy Weather, nothing is perfect. First, it’s important to note that it doesn’t exist on Google Play. You’ll need to install the app from GitHub or a place like F-Droid. Keep in mind that the F-Droid version only uses freenet standards, while the GitHub version has more weather sources and a few other small differences.Another issue is that there’s no radar. This is largely because there’s no free, open-source radar API that can compete with other weather apps out there right now, and so the app developers feel this is an impractical feature that doesn’t match the open-source nature of the project.
paragraph3: Gradient Weather looks great and has excellent radarJoe Maring / Android AuthorityBreezy Weather isn’t just about providing great customization and a solid UI. At its core, Breezy’s mission is to provide an open-source alternative to the big weather apps. Gradient Weather might not share the same open-source DNA, but it perfectly nails just about everything else.Gradient’s layout is quite a bit different from Breezy, but both are equally clean and easy to parse. You certainly have more glanceable options with Breezy, but Gradient does a good job of showing the most important information and hiding the rest out of the way. Where Gradient edges ahead is in the little finishing touches, like how it uses different colors for alerts, making it easy to know what the alert is for before you even fully read it.Gradient’s alerts are also very detailed, which is nice, as many alternatives (like Pixel Weather) tend to push you to a web browser for more detailed information. It’s not just more detailed alerts, either; Gradient also does a much better job with notifications.While Breezy keeps notifications fairly basic, Gradient goes the other way and can deliver custom notifications based on a wide range of weather conditions. Whether you want a frost alert or a notification that rain is coming, you’ll find an option here. Heck, you can even ask it to send basic alerts every morning so you know what the weather is like without turning to the app or its widgets. Speaking of widgets, Gradient offers a highly customizable experience that might not work the same as Breezy, but I’d argue the widgets are of the same quality.As I already mentioned, I love the idea of radar.
paragraph4: Whether it’s tracking incoming storms or just checking wind speed, I find radar a critical part of a modern weather app. Gradient does all this and so much more from its weather map. It also tracks cloud cover, temperature, and pressure. There’s even the ability to report real-time changes in weather conditions, which can help improve accuracy in your local area.Gradient and Breezy both offer tons of customization options and more; they just take different approaches to get there. Outside of the radar and better customizations, you’ll find a lot of similar features in Gradient that you’d already get from Breezy. Gradient’s proprietary app just takes a different approach. For example, you might not be able to manually change your data sources as you can with Breezy, but at least you’ll rest assured knowing that Gradient combines multiple data sources to improve accuracy rather than relying on a single fixed source.In many ways, I love how Breezy is open source and has a more manual approach to its feature set, but it also means that you have to mess around a lot more to find the right options. Gradient seemed to be a bit easier to “get right” out of the box. The only real downside is that you have to pay money to unlock the full experience.If you don’t want to spend a thing, I’d say Breezy Weather is the better choice here. Ultimately, it comes down to personal preference, though.
paragraph5: Both are great, but Gradient is the one for meJoe Maring / Android AuthorityBreezy Weather is excellent if you can live without radar and want a completely free experience that doesn’t hold features behind a paywall. It’s easy to use, easy to dive into, and, if you don’t mind the sideloading hurdles, a great choice for many.I personally didn’t mind paying the $33 for lifetime access to Gradient Weather in order to enjoy radar and the advanced notifications that Breezy just can’t compete with. There’s also the option to pay $3.50 per month or $22 annually.For me, Gradient’s deeper notifications and radar aren’t just nice; they could make a real difference during storm seasons. This is coming from someone who lives in the rural Midwest and is no stranger to sudden tornadoes or massive thunderstorms.Still, both apps remain great, and considering Breezy is free, it might not hurt to try them both and see for yourself.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.

title: Scam Detection could be coming to Galaxy S27, but there’s also good news for older phones
title_bn: গ্যালাক্সি এস২৭-এ এসক্যাম ডিটেকশন আসতে পারে, কিন্তু পুরোনো ফোনগুলোর জন্যও ভালো খবর আছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: You won't need the latest Samsung phone to get this super useful feature.
paragraph1: C. Scott Brown / Android AuthorityTL;DR Code in One UI 9 Beta 7 indicates Google and Samsung plan to bring Scam Detection to the upcoming Galaxy S27 lineup. The feature could also expand to the Galaxy S25 series, Galaxy Z Fold 7, Galaxy Z Flip 7, and Galaxy Z TriFold. The code also mentions the “s5e9975” (Exynos 2700) alongside a Qualcomm chip, signaling that Samsung may retain its dual-chipset strategy for 2027 flagships. Scam Detection started off as a Pixel-exclusive feature when it launched on the Pixel 9 series, but this year, Google shed that exclusivity by expanding it to the Galaxy S26 series.
paragraph2: Even Samsung’s newer Galaxy Z8 foldables support Scam Detection working through Samsung’s own Phone app, and the feature has been spotted in the works for vivo phones too. It seems Google has even more expansion in the cards, as we’ve spotted clues that it’s set to expand to even more Samsung flagships, including older foldables.You’re reading an Authority Insights story. Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else. Within One UI 9 Beta 7 for the Galaxy S26, we’ve spotted various clues that indicate that Google and Samsung intend to bring Scam Detection to the following existing and upcoming phones: Galaxy S25 series: Galaxy S25: SM-S931 Galaxy S25 Plus: SM-S936 Galaxy S25 Edge: SM-S937 Galaxy S25 Ultra: SM-S938 Galaxy Z Fold 7: SM-F966 Galaxy Z Flip 7: SM-F766 Galaxy Z TriFold: SM-F968 Galaxy S27 series: SM-S952: Likely the base Galaxy S27 SM-S956: Likely the Galaxy S27 Plus SM-S957: Likely the Galaxy S27 Pro SM-S958: Likely the Galaxy S27 Ultra All of these model numbers were mentioned in the code snippet related to the Scam Detection functionality, along with existing phones that support the feature.
paragraph3: Code snippets also suggest that the Galaxy S27 series will use a mix of Qualcomm and Exynos SoCs, depending on the region. More specifically, we’ve spotted mentions of “s5e9975,” which is expected to be the Exynos 2700, an SoC that Samsung has already confirmed. There are mentions of “qcom,” pointing to a Qualcomm SoC, but we couldn’t locate any specific model numbers in the code. All in all, this is another clue that Samsung could continue its dual-chipset strategy for its 2027 flagships, though the exact model and region split remains up in the air.While the presence of these model numbers indicates active testing and development, there’s no guarantee these phones will definitively get Scam Detection, though there’s a good chance they will.
paragraph4: The rollout timeline is also wide open: The Galaxy S27 series isn’t expected to launch for another few months, while Samsung’s older flagships are waiting for their One UI 9 betas to begin. So it’s unclear when these phones will get the feature. We’ll keep you updated when we learn more.⚠️ An APK teardown helps predict features that may arrive on a service in the future based on work-in-progress code. However, it is possible that such predicted features may not make it to a public release.

title: Pernia’s Pop-Up Parent IPO: Issue Subscribed 8% On Day 1 Till Now
title_bn: পপ-আপ প্যারেন্ট আইপিওঃ প্রথম দিনেই ৮ শতাংশ সাবস্ক্রাইব
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) got off to a subdued investor on the…
paragraph1: SUMMARYPernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) got off to a subdued investor on the first day of bidding PSL’s IPO will close on September 2 (Wednesday). Post the bidding, the company will list on the exchanges on September 7 (Monday) As of 14:48 IST, investors have cumulatively placed bids for 5.59 Lakh shares against 68.50 Lakh shares on offer, translating to a 8% subscription, as of 13:03 IST Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) got off to a subdued investor on the first day of bidding. As of 14:48 IST, investors have cumulatively placed bids for 5.59 Lakh shares against 68.50 Lakh shares on offer, translating to a 8% subscription, as of 13:03 IST.
paragraph2: The highest number of bids have come from retail investors till now, who have placed bids for 4.85 Lakh shares against the 12.45 Lakh shares earmarked for them. This translates to a 39% subscription of their quota. Following retail investors, non institutional investors (NIIs) have placed bids for 74,126 shares against the 18.68 Lakh shares reserved for them. This translates to a subscription of a mere 4% till now.
paragraph3: Meanwhile, qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) have shown the most muted interest in the issue. This section of investors placed bids for 364 shares against 37.36 Lakh shares reserved, translating to less than 1% subscription. PSL’s IPO will close on September 2 (Wednesday). The company has set a price band of ₹546 to ₹575 per share, valuing the company at ₹4,604 Cr at the upper end of the spectrum. Purple Style Labs’ public consists solely of a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹680 Cr, with no offer for sale component. Post the bidding, the company will list on the exchanges on September 7 (Monday).
paragraph4: A big chunk of the fresh IPO proceeds will be used to fund the lease liabilities of Pernia’s Pop Up Stores’ experience centres, while the remaining corpus will fund sales and marketing expenses till FY30. Founded in 2015 by Abhishek Agarwal, Purple Style Labs operates the multi-brand luxury omnichannel fashion platform Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop. The company claims to sell luxury fashion apparels sourced from 1,109 active designer brands. It sells its products via its own website as well as 12 experience centres. On the financial front, PSL’s consolidated net loss widened 51.5% to ₹285.4 Cr in FY26 compared to ₹188.
paragraph5: 4 Cr incurred in the previous fiscal year. Operating revenue for the fiscal rose nearly 14% to ₹557.8 Cr from ₹489.9 Cr in FY25.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার পপ আপ শপের মূল কোম্পানি পার্পল স্টাইল ল্যাবস প্রথম পাবলিক অফার (আইপিও) নিলামের প্রথম দিনে একটি মৃদু বিনিয়োগকারীকে পেয়েছিল পিএসএল এর আইপিও ২ সেপ্টেম্বর (বুধবার) বন্ধ হবে। নিলামের পরে, কোম্পানিটি ৭ সেপ্টেম্বরে (সোমবার) এক্সচেঞ্জে তালিকাভুক্ত হবে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই প্রকল্পের আওতায়, বেসরকারি বিনিয়োগকারীরা তাদের জন্য সংরক্ষিত ১৮.৬৮ লক্ষ শেয়ারের তুলনায় ৪.৮৫ লক্ষ শেয়ারের জন্য বিড করেছে। এটি তাদের কোটাটির ৩৯% সাবস্ক্রিপশনে অনুবাদ করে। খুচরা বিনিয়োগকারীদের পরে, নন-ইনস্টিটিউশনাল ইনভেস্টররা (এনআইআই) তাদের জন্য 18.68 লক্ষ শেয়ের তুলনায় 74,126 শেয়ারে বিড দিয়েছে। এটি এখন পর্যন্ত মাত্র ৪% সাবস্ক্রাইব করার অনুবাদ করেছে।
bangla_paragraph3: এদিকে, যোগ্য প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক ক্রেতাদের (কিউআইবি) ইস্যুতে সবচেয়ে নীরব আগ্রহ দেখা গেছে। বিনিয়োগকারীদের এই বিভাগটি ৩৬৪ শেয়ারের জন্য দরপত্র জমা দিয়েছে, সংরক্ষিত ৩৭.৩৬ লক্ষ শেয়ারে, যা ১% এরও কম সাবস্ক্রিপশনে অনুবাদ করে। পিএসএল এর আইপিও ২ সেপ্টেম্বর (বুধবার) বন্ধ হবে। সংস্থাটি প্রতি শেয়ার ৫৪৬ থেকে ৫৭৫ টাকার দামের ব্যাণ্ড নির্ধারণ করেছে, যা স্পেকট্রামের উপরের প্রান্তে সংস্থাটিকে ৪,৬০৪ কোটি টাকায় মূল্যায়ন করেছে। পার্পল স্টাইল ল্যাবস পাবলিক কেবলমাত্র ₹ 680 কোটি পর্যন্ত শেয়ারগুলির একটি তাজা ইস্যুর সমন্বয়ে গঠিত, যার সাথে
bangla_paragraph4: নতুন আইপিও থেকে প্রাপ্ত আয়ের একটি বড় অংশ পার্নিয়ার পপ আপ স্টোরগুলির অভিজ্ঞতা কেন্দ্রগুলির লিজ দায়বদ্ধতার জন্য ব্যবহার করা হবে, যখন অবশিষ্ট কর্পাসটি অর্থবছর পর্যন্ত বিক্রয় এবং বিপণনের ব্যয়কে অর্থায়ন করবে। ২০১৫ সালে অভিষেক আগরওয়াল দ্বারা প্রতিষ্ঠিত, পার্পল স্টাইল ল্যাবস মাল্টি-ব্র্যান্ড বিলাসবহুল ওমনিচ্যানেল ফ্যাশন প্ল্যাটফর্ম পার্নিয়া পপ-আপ শপ পরিচালনা করে। সংস্থাটি ১১০৯ টি সক্রিয় ডিজাইনার ব্র্যান্ড থেকে উত্সিত বিলাসিতা ফ্যাশনের পোশাক বিক্রি করার দাবি করে। এটি নিজস্ব ওয়েবসাইটের পাশাপাশি ১২ টি এক্সপেরিওর মাধ্যমে তার পণ্য বিক্রি করে।
bangla_paragraph5: গত অর্থবছরে ৪ কোটি টাকা আয় হয়েছে। অর্থবছরের অপারেটিং রাজস্ব প্রায় ১৪ শতাংশ বেড়ে ৫৫৭.৮ কোটি টাকা হয়েছে।

title: Google Clock is fine, but these 5 features would make it incredible
title_bn: গুগল ক্লক ঠিক আছে, কিন্তু এই ৫টি বৈশিষ্ট্যই এটাকে অবিশ্বাস্য করে তুলবে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google's principal timing and alarm app should draw inspiration from its third-party rivals.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityGoogle Clock might come preinstalled on several Android phones, but it’s not necessarily the best in its class. It’s not a particularly great alarm app, nor does it offer the range of timing features that more specialized apps do. It lurks somewhere in the middle, and its accessibility is the primary reason many use it.However, with just a few minor tweaks and upgrades, Google Clock could easily grow into one of Google’s gems. Looking over the fence at the host of other timing and alarm apps available on the market, here are just a few features I’d love to see Google integrate into its longstanding Clock app.Do you use Google Clock as your alarm app?629 votesAlarm tasks and challengesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityWhen I reviewed a quintet of Google Clock alternatives a few months ago, one standout feature that absolutely must come to the app is alarm tasks and challenges.After using the likes of Chrono and NFC Alarm Clock, I’ve grown used to solving various problems to disable the alarm rather than merely tapping a big stop button. The latter action can be accomplished by a half-sleep Andy pretty easily, whereas I need both brain hemispheres to complete a more complex conundrum.So, what are these “challenges” exactly? Well, taking a page out of Alarmy, NFC Alarm Clock, or Chrono’s books, these tasks could be anything from completing a mathematics problem to a traditional CAPTCHA.Challenges would force users to actively complete a task to disable their alarms.
paragraph2: I’d also like to see options to scan an NFC tag or QR code — both, if stuck on the bathroom door or coffee machine in the kitchen, would encourage me to physically get out of bed to silence my alarm. Then there are sliding puzzles, photo challenges, and physical challenges, like a set of squats or lunges. These are just some of the tasks third-party alarm clocks can perform.As I mentioned, being forced to complete a challenge to dismiss an alarm has helped wake me up every single time I use the app. It wouldn’t be too difficult for Google to integrate; the company could build mirror functionality into Wear OS and Android’s sister platforms, ensuring that no user accidentally dismisses their alarm ever again.More robust alarm fail-safesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityDovetailing with challenges, Google Clock could do with more alarm fail-safes built into the experience. While the app’s audio volume escalation is certainly one of my favorite features, it isn’t enough for truly stubborn sleepers.What would these fail-safes look like? Imagine a maximum-volume vibration mode that triggers after a specified cut-off time? My alarm is set for 7:00 AM, I have a meeting at 7:45 AM, but it’s 7:18 AM, and I’m still sleeping. At 7:20 AM, without any intervention from me, this panic-mode alarm would sound with full sound and fury. This mode could be built to trigger an audio alarm on Wear OS or even call a contact after a specified period as a last-ditch effort to wake the user.
paragraph3: Fail-safes would add another level of security in case the initial alarm doesn't do its job.I certainly don’t see such a mode necessary for use every single morning, but for those odd days when you have to wake up to catch a flight, the morning of check-out at a hotel, and for travelers who may be jetlagged and trying to adjust their schedule, it could be the difference between trouble and triumph.For snooze fiends, a snooze limit would be endlessly useful, while a “Wake up check” — a secondary alarm or notification that triggers 10 minutes or so after the alarm is dismissed — would be a welcome safety net for those who may have accidentally canceled their ringer and drifted off to sleep once again. This check could also be used to confirm that panic mode has been disabled.Better Bedtime Mode integrations and updatesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI’ll admit that there’s a problem with modern Google apps harboring too much bloat, but there is such a thing as good bulk. Bedtime Mode is a great example of a useful addition. It integrates into Google Clock’s alarm feature and triggers various on-device settings that make phone use more hospitable at night and more accommodating in the morning. However, it hasn’t seen any new features in quite a while.Here are some upgrades I’d like to see on Google Clock’s Bedtime Mode: More Sleep sounds: At present, there are only a handful of built-in options available. I’d appreciate brown, pink, and white noise tracks without requiring Spotify or another streaming service. Support for additional integrations: The Upcoming events section, which pulls data from Google Calendar, is infinitely useful for viewing forthcoming events, but Google can certainly pull from more sources. Google Tasks, a weather forecast, and guidance on when to leave home to reach a destination (be it work or the first event of the day) would all enhance this section’s utility.
paragraph4: More control over the Sunrise Alarm: One of Google Clock’s best features is its ability to slowly brighten the screen before the alarm actually sounds, but users have very little control over this process. Offering a few more settings, from the color displayed on the screen to when Sunrise Alarm actually triggers ahead of the audio alarm, would, again, add some welcome utility. A built-in Pomodoro timerAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI use the Pomodoro method to keep my day reliably plodding along. I’m currently using a separate app to keep my work and rest timings in check, but I’m always looking to slim down the number of apps I have installed on my phone. For that reason, I believe Google Clock could do with a built-in Pomodoro timer.This is an entirely selfish wish, but such a feature fits with Google’s overall focus on user wellness. A customizable Pomodoro timer would allow me to adjust work and rest intervals, determine how many sessions I complete before a longer rest, and keep a log of my progress throughout the day.I understand that some Google Clock users might see this as unnecessary bloat, but I believe it’ll benefit a host of Android users who use a separate Pomodoro app on their phones (like me).Customizable presets for timersAndy Walker / Android AuthorityFinally, speaking of timing specific periods, I can’t quite believe that Google Clock’s Timer page still lacks a list of recent and custom presets.I often use the app as a timer for cooking and baking, but each time I do, I have to enter the time manually. Not to sound entitled, this process requires at least three button presses, depending on the amount of time selected.Presets are available as widgets, but aren't accessible through the app itself.
paragraph5: This could easily be reduced to a single tap if Google includes a quartet or more of presets that users can customize and instantly select when required. It’s a simple addition that other clock apps offer and one that would add immense value to a host of Google Clock users. Google Clock is a competent Android app that has the potential to be far better than it currently is. Whether it’s more robust alarm features, richer timing smarts, or more customization options, I’d like to see Google do a little more for this app that millions of Android users rely on daily.If you could improve Google Clock, what feature would you like to see added or refined? Let me know in the comments section below.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.

Bedtime Mode is a great example of a useful addition. It integrates into Google Clock’s alarm feature and triggers various on-device settings that make phone use more hospitable at night and more accommodating in the morning. However, it hasn’t seen any new features in quite a while.Here are some upgrades I’d like to see on Google Clock’s Bedtime Mode: More Sleep sounds: At present, there are only a handful of built-in options available. I’d appreciate brown, pink, and white noise tracks without requiring Spotify or another streaming service. Support for additional integrations: The Upcoming events section, which pulls data from Google Calendar, is infinitely useful for viewing forthcoming events, but Google can certainly pull from more sources. Google Tasks, a weather forecast, and guidance on when to leave home to reach a destination (be it work or the first event of the day) would all enhance this section’s utility.
bangla_paragraph4: More control over the Sunrise Alarm: One of Google Clock’s best features is its ability to slowly brighten the screen before the alarm actually sounds, but users have very little control over this process. Offering a few more settings, from the color displayed on the screen to when Sunrise Alarm actually triggers ahead of the audio alarm, would, again, add some welcome utility. A built-in Pomodoro timerAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI use the Pomodoro method to keep my day reliably plodding along. I’m currently using a separate app to keep my work and rest timings in check, but I’m always looking to slim down the number of apps I have installed on my phone. For that reason, I believe Google Clock could do with a built-in Pomodoro timer.This is an entirely selfish wish, but such a feature fits with Google’s overall focus on user wellness. A customizable Pomodoro timer would allow me to adjust work and rest intervals, determine how many sessions I complete before a longer rest, and keep a log of my progress throughout the day.I understand that some Google Clock users might see this as unnecessary bloat, but I believe it’ll benefit a host of Android users who use a separate Pomodoro app on their phones (like me).Customizable presets for timersAndy Walker / Android AuthorityFinally, speaking of timing specific periods, I can’t quite believe that Google Clock’s Timer page still lacks a list of recent and custom presets.I often use the app as a timer for cooking and baking, but each time I do, I have to enter the time manually. Not to sound entitled, this process requires at least three button presses, depending on the amount of time selected.Presets are available as widgets, but aren't accessible through the app itself.
bangla_paragraph5: This could easily be reduced to a single tap if Google includes a quartet or more of presets that users can customize and instantly select when required. It’s a simple addition that other clock apps offer and one that would add immense value to a host of Google Clock users. Google Clock is a competent Android app that has the potential to be far better than it currently is. Whether it’s more robust alarm features, richer timing smarts, or more customization options, I’d like to see Google do a little more for this app that millions of Android users rely on daily.If you could improve Google Clock, what feature would you like to see added or refined? Let me know in the comments section below.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.

title: Man uses robot vacuum to covertly record his wife's affair, wins divorce settlement but gets sentenced to prison for making an illegal recording — Husband lands behind bars after counter-suit over privacy rights
title_bn: স্বামী তার স্ত্রীর সম্পর্ক গোপনে রেকর্ড করতে রোবট ভ্যাকুয়াম ব্যবহার করে, বিবাহ বিচ্ছেদ চুক্তিতে জয়ী হয় কিন্তু অবৈধ রেকর্ডিং করার জন্য কারাদণ্ড পায়  গোপনীয়তার অধিকার নিয়ে প্রতিপক্ষের মামলার পর স্বামী জেলখানার পিছনে পড়ে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: A Taiwanese man sued his wife for having an affair using recordings from a robot vacuum to prove his case. He won, but got sued by the wife for infringing on her personal privacy and was fined the equivalent of 30% of what he earned as compensation p
paragraph1: (Image credit: Getty) In a strange turn of events under Taiwanese law, both parties in a judicial contest lost against each other. A man sued his wife for having an extramarital affair and used footage from a robot vacuum to prove his case. He ultimately won the lawsuit and was awarded a healthy ~$19,000 USD in compensation for emotional distress, but since he secretly recorded his wife, she sued him back for invading her privacy. The courts ruled in her favor, forcing the man to pay a fine equal to 30% of what he'd just earned, along with a sentence of five months in prison.The couple got married in 2021 and used to live with their parents, but they would occasionally spend time in their holiday home. During a vacation in 2023, the man discovered a used toothbrush in their bathroom, sparking suspicion that was confirmed by checking CCTV footage from a parking garage.
paragraph2: In the footage, he saw another person who had driven his wife home before, hypothesizing him as his wife's partner in crime.Three months later, he used a robot vacuum app to try to remotely contact his wife but, upon doing so, stumbled upon something shocking: The footage from the robot vacuum's camera showed his wife changing her clothes, getting in bed with the same person he had previously identified, and walking around the house naked while the other man comfortably sank into their sofa. He recorded the entire thing to use as evidence in a lawsuit that he brought shortly after.Cheating is not a criminal offense under Taiwanese law, but infringing on someone's marital rights can still yield monetary compensation because it's a breach of contract. As such, the man sought a 2 million TWD (Taiwanese dollar), or roughly $63,000, reimbursement from his wife and her new lover. He used the footage from the robot vacuum's camera feed to prove that their relationship expanded far beyond casual friendship and the judges ruled in his favor.
paragraph3: He won 500,000 TWD in compensation, which translates to $19,000. However, the fight was far from over.Since recording someone without their consent is illegal across most parts of the world, including Taiwan, there were grounds for a counter-lawsuit for evidence collection. As such, the wife sued him for recording private, intimate footage of her and argued that the sensors and lights on the robot vacuum cleaner weren't enough to indicate she was being filmed. The man contended that the courts already admitted the footage as evidence, so it wasn't illegal material.However, it was still obtained via illegal means, so the courts rejected his defense on the basis of invading the wife's privacy.
paragraph4: In the hierarchy of constitution, individual rights outweigh marital duties. He was fined 150,000 TWD ($4,700) and sentenced to prison for five months. It won't be unreasonable to say that prison time is a much worse outcome than any amount of compensation paid by the other party. Not to mention having a criminal record on your name can tarnish your civil reputation.Without the smoking gun that was the robot vacuum footage, the marriage lawsuit could've dragged on for much longer, draining the man of his time, energy, and money in place of a swift verdict. Still, the fact that the husband has to go to jail and pay the equivalent of 30% of his payout back to the state as a fine basically negates the financial gain from the marriage lawsuit.
paragraph5: This was a net loss, especially when you consider he already only received a fraction of the 2 million TWD compensation initially sought.Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox. title: WhatsApp ‘Scam Alert’ feature begins beta testing on Android: How it helps block fraudsters
title_bn: অ্যান্ড্রয়েডে হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের স্ক্যাম সতর্কতা বৈশিষ্ট্যটি বেটা টেস্টিং শুরু করেছেঃ এটি কীভাবে জালিয়াতিকারীদের ব্লক করতে সহায়তা করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: WhatsApp has started testing its new Scam Alert feature with select Android beta users. The tool uses on-device machine learning to identify potentially fraudulent messages from unknown contacts.
paragraph1: WhatsApp has started testing its new Scam Alert feature with select Android beta users. The tool uses on-device machine learning to identify potentially fraudulent messages from unknown contacts.Users can block, report or trust flagged chats, while Meta says message content is not automatically shared for detection.(AI Generated )WhatsApp is beginning to roll out an all-new Scam Alert feature to a small number of Android beta users. The tool is built to alert users if messages from unknown contacts exhibit a pattern of behaviours that are common in scams. It uses on-device machine learning, meaning that it doesn't require sending the content of a suspicious message to Meta for analysis.WABetaInfo says the feature is being shown to a select few testers in WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.
paragraph2: 34.1. Meta had previously explained how the technology worked, but the introduction of the feature in the beta version means WhatsApp is getting closer to rolling it out to a wider audience. The official release date has not been announced yet.How WhatsApp scam alert worksScam Alert is an optional feature that users must enable manually. The setting is available to beta users with access under Settings > Account.If activated, an on-device machine learning model analyzes incoming messages from contacts not saved in the user's contact list. Searches for patterns that have been linked to known scam calls.
paragraph3: Whenever a message is flagged as potentially suspicious, it will display a warning in the chat. Only the recipient can see the warning and not the sender.The user is then given the option to continue the conversation or block and report the account. If WhatsApp flags a genuine conversation as spam, they can mark it as trusted. The warning for that conversation will then no longer be displayed in Scam Alert.Meta says scam detection happens on deviceOne of the important modalities in which the feature works is through privacy. The machine learning model is downloaded to the user's device, where the classification is done on the device itself, says Meta.Meta says that the content of the messages doesn't automatically go to WhatsApp, Meta or a third party for scam classification.
paragraph4: Users also will not automatically be alerted to messages when the system provides a warning.If they think a warning was wrong, users can voluntarily send their last five messages to WhatsApp to help improve the system. Based on the patterns seen in scam conversations reported by users, the model has been trained by Meta, according to the company. The on-device feature also enables WhatsApp to add another layer of security without compromising its end-to-end encryption.Why WhatsApp's new scam warning mattersFraudsters often exploit messaging apps for fake offers, investment opportunities, delivery scams, claims to win prizes or impersonation. A warning before users interact with an unknown user might give them one more chance to detect the suspicious action.Currently, Scam Alert is available for only some Android beta testers. WhatsApp hasn't revealed when this feature will be available to all Android users, nor has it indicated whether it will be available on Apple iPhones concurrently.

bangla_paragraph1: হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ নির্বাচিত অ্যান্ড্রয়েড বিটা ব্যবহারকারীদের সাথে তার নতুন স্ক্যাম সতর্কতা বৈশিষ্ট্যটি পরীক্ষা শুরু করেছে। অজানা পরিচিতিগুলির সম্ভাব্য জালিয়াতিপূর্ণ বার্তাগুলি সনাক্ত করতে সরঞ্জামটি ডিভাইসে মেশিন লার্নিং ব্যবহার করে। ব্যবহারকারীরা ফ্ল্যাগযুক্ত চ্যাটগুলি ব্লক, রিপোর্ট বা বিশ্বাস করতে পারে, যখন মেটা বলে যে বার্তার সামগ্রী স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সনাক্তকরণের জন্য ভাগ করা হয় না।
bangla_paragraph2: 34.1. মেটা আগে ব্যাখ্যা করেছিল যে প্রযুক্তিটি কীভাবে কাজ করে, তবে বিটা সংস্করণে বৈশিষ্ট্যটির প্রবর্তনের অর্থ হ'ল হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ এটিকে আরও বিস্তৃত শ্রোতাদের কাছে প্রবর্তন করার কাছাকাছি চলেছে। আনুষ্ঠানিক প্রকাশের তারিখটি এখনও ঘোষণা করা হয়নি। হোয়াটেসঅপ কেলেঙ্কারির সতর্কতা কীভাবে কাজ করবেস্কম সতর্কতা একটি ঐচ্ছিক বৈশিষ্ট্য যা ব্যবহারকারীদের ম্যানুয়ালি সক্ষম করতে হবে। সেটিংস> অ্যাকাউন্টের অধীনে অ্যাক্সেস সহ বিটা ব্যবহারকারীদের জন্য সেটিংস উপলব্ধ। যদি সক্রিয় করা হয় তবে ডিভাইসে একটি মেশিন লার্নিং মডেল কো থেকে আগত বার্তাগুলি বিশ্লেষণ করে।
bangla_paragraph3: যখনই কোনও বার্তা সম্ভাব্য সন্দেহজনক হিসাবে চিহ্নিত করা হয়, এটি চ্যাটে একটি সতর্কতা প্রদর্শন করবে। কেবলমাত্র প্রাপকই সতর্কতাটি দেখতে পারে এবং প্রেরক নয়। ব্যবহারকারীকে তারপরে কথোপকথন চালিয়ে যাওয়ার বা অ্যাকাউন্টটি ব্লক এবং রিপোর্ট করার বিকল্প দেওয়া হয়। যদি হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ কোনও আসল কথোপকাঠাকে স্প্যাম হিসাবে চিহ্নित করে তবে তারা এটিকে বিশ্বাসযোগ্য হিসাবে চিহ্নযুক্ত করতে পারে। সেই কথোপकথনের জন্য সতর্কতা তখন আর প্রদর্শিত হবে না স্ক্যাম সতর্কতা.মেটা বলেছে যে স্ক্যাম সনাক্তকরণ ডিভাইসে ঘটে।
bangla_paragraph4: ব্যবহারকারীরা সিস্টেমটি যখন একটি সতর্কতা প্রদান করে তখন ব্যবহারকারীদের স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে বার্তাগুলি সম্পর্কে সতর্ক করা হবে না। যদি তারা মনে করে যে একটি সতর্কবার্তা ভুল ছিল, ব্যবহারকারীগণ স্বেচ্ছায় তাদের শেষ পাঁচটি বার্তা হোয়াটসঅ্যাপে পাঠাতে পারেন যাতে সিস্টেম উন্নত করতে সহায়তা করতে পারে। ব্যবহারকারীদের দ্বারা রিপোর্ট করা কেলেঙ্কারী কথোপকথনে দেখা নিদর্শনগুলির উপর ভিত্তি করে, মডেলটি মেটা দ্বারা প্রশিক্ষিত হয়েছে, সংস্থা অনুসারে। অন-ডিভাইস বৈশিষ্ট্যটি হোয়াટসঅপকে তার শেষ থেকে শেষ এনক্রিপশনকে আপস না করে আরও একটি স্তর সুরক্ষা যুক্ত করতে সক্ষম করে। কেন হোয়াটেসের নতুন কেলেংকারী যুদ্ধ
bangla_paragraph5: লেখক সম্পর্কেপ্রজ্ঞা সিংহ রায়প্রজ্ঞা ডিজিটাল মিডিয়া এবং কন্টেন্ট লেখার চার বছরেরও বেশি অভিজ্ঞতার সাথে একটি প্রযুক্তি প্রতিবেদক। তিনি সাংবাদিকতায় স্নাতকোত্তর ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন এবং মহাকাশ, স্মার্টফোন, গ্যাজেট, কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা, উদীয়মান প্রযুক্তি এবং প্রযুক্তি দৈনন্দিন জীবনকে রূপান্তরিত করার উপায়গুলি জুড়ে বিস্তৃত গল্পগুলি কভার করেছেন। তিনি জটিল প্রযুক্তি এবং বিজ্ঞান উন্নয়নগুলিকে পরিষ্কার, আকর্ষক এবং পাঠক-বান্ধব গল্পগুলিতে ভেঙে ফেলার দিকে মনোনিবেশ করেন, একটি ধারালো বুদ্ধি সহ।

title: This fan-favorite image editor is the first app to support Android’s new location data controls
title_bn: এই ফ্যান-প্রেমীয় ইমেজ এডিটর হল অ্যান্ড্রয়েডের নতুন অবস্থান তথ্য নিয়ন্ত্রণের জন্য প্রথম অ্যাপ্লিকেশন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: You can now choose to keep or remove location data when using Android's Photo Picker. And here's the first supported app.
paragraph1: Mishaal Rahman / Android AuthorityTL;DR Snapseed is the first app to implement the new location metadata API in Android’s Photo Picker. When you use the Photo Picker to choose an image in Snapseed, it’ll now ask whether you want to include the picture’s location info. This is a welcome move as it gives users greater control over sensitive metadata. Google recently announced a major improvement to Android’s Photo Picker. The photo picker will allow users to choose whether to keep or remove location data in shared images.
paragraph2: It seems like the waiting is over if you really want to try this feature.You’re reading an Authority Insights story. Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.Google has rolled out the Photo Picker’s location metadata API with the August Mainline Android update, and it looks like Snapseed (v4.1.
paragraph3: 5.970833206) has already implemented this functionality. As a result, Snapseed now displays a prompt to include an image’s location info when you choose an image to edit via Android’s Photo Picker. Check out the first screenshot below.We can also see a floating location info toggle in the bottom-right corner of the Photo Picker.
paragraph4: Tapping this button lets you quickly enable or disable access to location metadata, with a crossed-out icon indicating that location data isn’t being shared. I’m guessing this could be useful if you made the wrong choice via the preceding pop-up menu.We’re glad to see the first apps embracing this new API, as it gives users greater control over some sensitive data. Photo editing apps on Android often strip out location data, so the ability to retain this info for specific images is pretty handy. On the other hand, the ability to manually remove location data is extremely useful for sensitive photos.
